=== START OF FILE: ./src/heap.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — heap.c
// Шаг 5: slab-аллокатор поверх physmem
//
// Идея: фиксированные бакеты, страницы нарезаются на объекты.
// Каждый объект префиксится 8-байтовым заголовком:
//   [u32 magic][u32 bucket_idx][payload ...]
//
// kmalloc() возвращает указатель на payload (slot + 8).
// kfree() восстанавливает slot и bucket_idx из заголовка.
//
// Ограничение: пока поддерживаются только объекты <= 2048 байт.
// Для более крупных аллокаций используй phys_alloc_page() напрямую.

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include "heap.h"
#include "physmem.h"

#define NUM_BUCKETS 8
#define HEAP_MAGIC  0xB1055EEDu

static const size_t bucket_sizes[NUM_BUCKETS] = {
    16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048
};

// Свободный объект: на payload-месте лежит указатель на следующий свободный.
typedef struct free_obj {
    struct free_obj *next;
} free_obj_t;

// Заголовок каждого slot. 8 байт.
typedef struct slot_hdr {
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t bucket;
} slot_hdr_t;

static free_obj_t *buckets[NUM_BUCKETS];

// Размер слота: заголовок + payload, выровнен на 16.
static size_t slot_size(int i) {
    size_t raw = bucket_sizes[i] + sizeof(slot_hdr_t);
    return (raw + 15) & ~(size_t)15;
}

// Взять страницу из physmem, нарезать на слоты, все положить в свободный список.
static int refill(int i) {
    uint8_t *page = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    if (!page) return -1;

    size_t ss = slot_size(i);
    size_t n  = PAGE_SIZE / ss;
    if (n == 0) return -1;

    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        uint8_t *slot = page + k * ss;
        slot_hdr_t *h = (slot_hdr_t *)slot;
        h->magic  = HEAP_MAGIC;
        h->bucket = (uint32_t)i;

        free_obj_t *fo = (free_obj_t *)(slot + sizeof(slot_hdr_t));
        fo->next = buckets[i];
        buckets[i] = fo;
    }
    return 0;
}

void heap_init(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_BUCKETS; i++) {
        buckets[i] = 0;
    }
}

void *kmalloc(size_t size) {
    if (size == 0 || size > HEAP_MAX_ALLOC) return 0;

    int i = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < NUM_BUCKETS; k++) {
        if (size <= bucket_sizes[k]) { i = k; break; }
    }
    if (i < 0) return 0;

    if (!buckets[i]) {
        if (refill(i) < 0) return 0;
    }

    free_obj_t *fo = buckets[i];
    buckets[i] = fo->next;
    return (void *)fo;
}

void kfree(void *ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;

    uint8_t    *slot = (uint8_t *)ptr - sizeof(slot_hdr_t);
    slot_hdr_t *h    = (slot_hdr_t *)slot;

    if (h->magic != HEAP_MAGIC) return;       // мусорный указатель — игнорируем
    if (h->bucket >= NUM_BUCKETS) return;

    free_obj_t *fo = (free_obj_t *)ptr;
    fo->next = buckets[h->bucket];
    buckets[h->bucket] = fo;
}
=== END OF FILE ===


=== START OF FILE: ./src/rtc.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — rtc.c
// PL031 RTC на QEMU virt. Читает Unix seconds и конвертирует в Y-M-D H:M:S.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "rtc.h"

#define PL031_BASE  0x09010000u
#define PL031_DR    ((volatile uint32_t *)(PL031_BASE + 0x00))

// Из алгоритма Howard Hinnant (public domain).
// Дни от 1970-01-01 → Y-M-D.
static void civil_from_days(int64_t z, int *y, int *m, int *d) {
    z += 719468;
    int64_t era = (z >= 0 ? z : z - 146096) / 146097;
    uint64_t doe = (uint64_t)(z - era * 146097);
    uint64_t yoe = (doe - doe/1460 + doe/36524 - doe/146096) / 365;
    int64_t  yy  = (int64_t)yoe + era * 400;
    uint64_t doy = doe - (365*yoe + yoe/4 - yoe/100);
    uint64_t mp  = (5*doy + 2) / 153;
    uint64_t dd  = doy - (153*mp+2)/5 + 1;
    uint64_t mm  = mp + (mp < 10 ? 3 : -9);
    *y = (int)(yy + (mm <= 2));
    *m = (int)mm;
    *d = (int)dd;
}

void rtc_get(int tz_hours,
             int *y, int *mo, int *d,
             int *h, int *mi, int *s)
{
    uint32_t base = *PL031_DR;
    // Сдвиг часового пояса.
    int64_t t = (int64_t)base + (int64_t)tz_hours * 3600;

    int64_t days = t / 86400;
    int secs     = (int)(t % 86400);
    if (secs < 0) { secs += 86400; days -= 1; }

    int hh = secs / 3600;
    int mm = (secs % 3600) / 60;
    int ss = secs % 60;

    int yy, mo_, dd;
    civil_from_days(days, &yy, &mo_, &dd);

    *y = yy; *mo = mo_; *d = dd;
    *h = hh; *mi = mm; *s = ss;
}

static void put2(char *buf, int *i, int v) {
    buf[(*i)++] = (char)('0' + (v / 10) % 10);
    buf[(*i)++] = (char)('0' + (v % 10));
}

void rtc_format_hm_utc3(char *buf, int max) {
    int y, mo, d, h, mi, s;
    rtc_get(3, &y, &mo, &d, &h, &mi, &s);
    int i = 0;
    put2(buf, &i, h);
    buf[i++] = ':';
    put2(buf, &i, mi);
    buf[i] = 0;
    (void)max;
}

void rtc_format_full_utc3(char *buf, int max) {
    int y, mo, d, h, mi, s;
    rtc_get(3, &y, &mo, &d, &h, &mi, &s);
    int i = 0;
    put2(buf, &i, d);
    buf[i++] = '/';
    put2(buf, &i, mo);
    buf[i++] = ' ';
    put2(buf, &i, h);
    buf[i++] = ':';
    put2(buf, &i, mi);
    buf[i] = 0;
    (void)max;
}
=== END OF FILE ===


=== START OF FILE: ./src/physmem.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — physmem.c
// Шаг 7: bitmap-аллокатор, банки RAM берутся из DTB.
// Шаг 8: phys_alloc_pages() для многостраничных блоков (стеки задач).

#include <stdint.h>
#include "physmem.h"
#include "dtb.h"

#define MAX_BANKS 4
#define MAX_PAGES (1024ull * 1024)

typedef struct {
    uint64_t base;
    uint64_t first_page;
    uint64_t num_pages;
} bank_t;

static bank_t   g_banks[MAX_BANKS];
static int      g_num_banks   = 0;
static uint64_t g_total_pages = 0;

static uint64_t bitmap[MAX_PAGES / 64];

extern char _end;

static inline void bm_set  (uint64_t i) { bitmap[i / 64] |=  (1ull << (i % 64)); }
static inline void bm_clear(uint64_t i) { bitmap[i / 64] &= ~(1ull << (i % 64)); }
static inline int  bm_test (uint64_t i) { return (bitmap[i / 64] >> (i % 64)) & 1; }

static int bank_of(uint64_t pa) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_num_banks; i++) {
        uint64_t s = g_banks[i].base;
        uint64_t e = s + g_banks[i].num_pages * PAGE_SIZE;
        if (pa >= s && pa < e) return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

static void reserve_range(uint64_t pa_start, uint64_t pa_end) {
    for (int b = 0; b < g_num_banks; b++) {
        uint64_t b_start = g_banks[b].base;
        uint64_t b_end   = b_start + g_banks[b].num_pages * PAGE_SIZE;

        uint64_t s = pa_start > b_start ? pa_start : b_start;
        uint64_t e = pa_end   < b_end   ? pa_end   : b_end;
        if (s >= e) continue;

        uint64_t first = g_banks[b].first_page + (s - b_start) / PAGE_SIZE;
        uint64_t last  = g_banks[b].first_page +
                         (e - b_start + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE;
        for (uint64_t i = first; i < last; i++) bm_set(i);
    }
}

static uint64_t fdt_size(const void *dtb) {
    if (!dtb) return 0;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)dtb;
    uint32_t magic = ((uint32_t)p[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 16) |
                     ((uint32_t)p[2] << 8)  |  (uint32_t)p[3];
    if (magic != 0xD00DFEEDu) return 0;
    return ((uint64_t)p[4] << 24) | ((uint64_t)p[5] << 16) |
           ((uint64_t)p[6] << 8)  |  (uint64_t)p[7];
}

void physmem_init(void) {
    ram_bank_t dtb_banks[MAX_BANKS];
    int n = dtb_get_ram_banks(dtb_banks, MAX_BANKS);

    if (n == 0) {
        dtb_banks[0].base = 0x40000000ull;
        dtb_banks[0].size = 128ull * 1024 * 1024;
        n = 1;
    }

    g_num_banks = 0;
    g_total_pages = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t pages = dtb_banks[i].size / PAGE_SIZE;
        if (pages == 0) continue;
        if (g_total_pages + pages > MAX_PAGES) break;

        g_banks[g_num_banks].base       = dtb_banks[i].base;
        g_banks[g_num_banks].first_page = g_total_pages;
        g_banks[g_num_banks].num_pages  = pages;

        g_total_pages += pages;
        g_num_banks++;
    }

    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < MAX_PAGES / 64; i++) bitmap[i] = 0;

    if (g_num_banks > 0) {
        reserve_range(g_banks[0].base, (uint64_t)&_end);
    }

    const void *dtb = dtb_get_ptr();
    uint64_t dsz = fdt_size(dtb);
    if (dsz > 0) {
        reserve_range((uint64_t)dtb, (uint64_t)dtb + dsz);
    }
}

void *phys_alloc_page(void) {
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < g_total_pages; i++) {
        if (bm_test(i)) continue;
        bm_set(i);

        for (int b = 0; b < g_num_banks; b++) {
            if (i < g_banks[b].first_page + g_banks[b].num_pages) {
                uint64_t off = i - g_banks[b].first_page;
                return (void *)(g_banks[b].base + off * PAGE_SIZE);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void *phys_alloc_pages(uint64_t n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    if (n == 1) return phys_alloc_page();

    for (int b = 0; b < g_num_banks; b++) {
        uint64_t first = g_banks[b].first_page;
        uint64_t count = g_banks[b].num_pages;

        uint64_t i = 0;
        while (i + n <= count) {
            int ok = 1;
            for (uint64_t k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                if (bm_test(first + i + k)) { ok = 0; break; }
            }
            if (ok) {
                for (uint64_t k = 0; k < n; k++) bm_set(first + i + k);
                return (void *)(g_banks[b].base + i * PAGE_SIZE);
            }
            i++;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void phys_free_page(void *pa) {
    if (!pa) return;
    uint64_t addr = (uint64_t)pa;
    if (addr & (PAGE_SIZE - 1)) return;

    int b = bank_of(addr);
    if (b < 0) return;

    uint64_t off = (addr - g_banks[b].base) / PAGE_SIZE;
    bm_clear(g_banks[b].first_page + off);
}

uint64_t physmem_total_pages(void) { return g_total_pages; }

uint64_t physmem_free_pages(void) {
    uint64_t free = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < g_total_pages; i++) {
        if (!bm_test(i)) free++;
    }
    return free;
}
=== END OF FILE ===


=== START OF FILE: ./src/bkfs.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — bkfs.c
// Реализация BKFS. 512-байтные блоки, 256 inode, прямые блоки.
// Без libc: структурные копии делаются вручную.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "bkfs.h"
#include "blk.h"

extern void uart_puts(const char *s);
extern void uart_putu(uint64_t v);

#define BKFS_MAGIC        0x53464B42u  // 'BKFS' little-endian
#define BKFS_VERSION      1u
#define BKFS_BLOCK_SIZE   512u
#define BKFS_INODE_COUNT  256u
#define BKFS_INODE_START  1u
#define BKFS_INODE_SECTORS ((BKFS_INODE_COUNT * 128u) / BKFS_BLOCK_SIZE)  // 64
#define BKFS_DATA_START   (BKFS_INODE_START + BKFS_INODE_SECTORS)         // 65
#define BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE 15

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t version;
    uint32_t block_size;
    uint32_t total_blocks;
    uint32_t inode_count;
    uint32_t inode_start;
    uint32_t data_start;
    uint8_t  reserved[512 - 7 * 4];
} bkfs_super_t;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint8_t  type;
    char     name[59];
    uint32_t size;
    uint32_t blocks[BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE];
    uint8_t  pad[4];
} bkfs_inode_t;

static uint8_t g_sec[512];

static bkfs_super_t g_super;
static int          g_ready = 0;

static uint32_t g_inode_cache_sector = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

static int str_eq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) { if (*a++ != *b++) return 0; }
    return *a == 0 && *b == 0;
}

static void str_copy_n(char *dst, const char *src, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    while (src[i] && i < max - 1) { dst[i] = src[i]; i++; }
    dst[i] = 0;
}

// Ручное копирование байтов (замена memcpy).
static void bytes_copy(void *dst, const void *src, uint32_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    const uint8_t *s = (const uint8_t *)src;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = s[i];
}

static void bytes_zero(void *dst, uint32_t n) {
    uint8_t *d = (uint8_t *)dst;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = 0;
}

// ---- Работа с inode ----
static int inode_load_sector(uint32_t inode_idx) {
    uint32_t off_bytes = inode_idx * 128u;
    uint32_t sector = BKFS_INODE_START + off_bytes / 512u;
    if (sector == g_inode_cache_sector) return 1;
    if (!blk_read_sector(sector, g_sec)) return 0;
    g_inode_cache_sector = sector;
    return 1;
}

static bkfs_inode_t *inode_ptr(uint32_t inode_idx) {
    uint32_t off = (inode_idx * 128u) % 512u;
    return (bkfs_inode_t *)(g_sec + off);
}

static int inode_load(uint32_t idx, bkfs_inode_t *out) {
    if (idx >= BKFS_INODE_COUNT) return 0;
    if (!inode_load_sector(idx)) return 0;
    bytes_copy(out, inode_ptr(idx), sizeof(bkfs_inode_t));
    return 1;
}

static int inode_store(uint32_t idx, const bkfs_inode_t *in) {
    if (idx >= BKFS_INODE_COUNT) return 0;
    if (!inode_load_sector(idx)) return 0;
    bytes_copy(inode_ptr(idx), in, sizeof(bkfs_inode_t));

    uint32_t off_bytes = idx * 128u;
    uint32_t sector = BKFS_INODE_START + off_bytes / 512u;
    if (!blk_write_sector(sector, g_sec)) return 0;
    g_inode_cache_sector = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    return 1;
}

static int inode_find(const char *name, uint32_t *out_idx) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < BKFS_INODE_COUNT; i++) {
        if (!inode_load_sector(i)) return 0;
        bkfs_inode_t *p = inode_ptr(i);
        if (p->type == 0) continue;
        if (str_eq(p->name, name)) {
            *out_idx = i;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int inode_alloc(uint32_t *out_idx) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < BKFS_INODE_COUNT; i++) {
        if (!inode_load_sector(i)) return 0;
        bkfs_inode_t *p = inode_ptr(i);
        if (p->type == 0) {
            *out_idx = i;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- Аллокация блоков ----
static int is_block_used(uint32_t sector) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < BKFS_INODE_COUNT; i++) {
        if (!inode_load_sector(i)) return 1;
        bkfs_inode_t *p = inode_ptr(i);
        if (p->type == 0) continue;
        for (int b = 0; b < BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE; b++) {
            if (p->blocks[b] == sector) return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int alloc_block(uint32_t *out) {
    uint32_t data_blocks = g_super.total_blocks - BKFS_DATA_START;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < data_blocks; i++) {
        uint32_t s = BKFS_DATA_START + i;
        if (!is_block_used(s)) {
            *out = s;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- Публичный API ----
int bkfs_init(void) {
    g_ready = 0;
    g_inode_cache_sector = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    if (!blk_read_sector(0, g_sec)) return 0;

    bkfs_super_t *sp = (bkfs_super_t *)g_sec;
    if (sp->magic != BKFS_MAGIC) return 0;
    if (sp->version != BKFS_VERSION) return 0;
    if (sp->block_size != BKFS_BLOCK_SIZE) return 0;

    bytes_copy(&g_super, sp, sizeof(bkfs_super_t));
    g_ready = 1;
    return 1;
}

int bkfs_is_ready(void) { return g_ready; }

int bkfs_format(void) {
    uint64_t total = blk_capacity();
    if (total == 0) return BKFS_EIO;

    bytes_zero(g_sec, 512);
    bkfs_super_t *sp = (bkfs_super_t *)g_sec;
    sp->magic        = BKFS_MAGIC;
    sp->version      = BKFS_VERSION;
    sp->block_size   = BKFS_BLOCK_SIZE;
    sp->total_blocks = (uint32_t)total;
    sp->inode_count  = BKFS_INODE_COUNT;
    sp->inode_start  = BKFS_INODE_START;
    sp->data_start   = BKFS_DATA_START;

    if (!blk_write_sector(0, g_sec)) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint8_t zero[512];
    bytes_zero(zero, 512);
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < BKFS_INODE_SECTORS; s++) {
        if (!blk_write_sector(BKFS_INODE_START + s, zero)) return BKFS_EIO;
    }

    bytes_copy(&g_super, sp, sizeof(bkfs_super_t));
    g_ready = 1;
    g_inode_cache_sector = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    return BKFS_OK;
}

int bkfs_create(const char *name) {
    if (!g_ready) return BKFS_EIO;
    if (!name || !name[0]) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint32_t existing;
    if (inode_find(name, &existing)) return BKFS_EEXIST;

    uint32_t idx;
    if (!inode_alloc(&idx)) return BKFS_ENOSPC;

    bkfs_inode_t in;
    bytes_zero(&in, sizeof(in));
    in.type = 1;
    str_copy_n(in.name, name, 59);
    in.size = 0;

    if (!inode_store(idx, &in)) return BKFS_EIO;
    return BKFS_OK;
}

int bkfs_write(const char *name, const void *data, uint32_t len) {
    if (!g_ready) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint32_t idx;
    if (!inode_find(name, &idx)) return BKFS_ENOENT;

    bkfs_inode_t in;
    if (!inode_load(idx, &in)) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint32_t max_bytes = BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE * BKFS_BLOCK_SIZE;
    if (len > max_bytes) len = max_bytes;

    for (int b = 0; b < BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE; b++) in.blocks[b] = 0;

    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)data;
    uint32_t written = 0;
    uint32_t blk_idx = 0;

    while (written < len && blk_idx < BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE) {
        uint32_t s;
        if (!alloc_block(&s)) return BKFS_ENOSPC;

        uint8_t buf[512];
        uint32_t chunk = len - written;
        if (chunk > 512) chunk = 512;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < chunk; i++) buf[i] = src[written + i];
        for (uint32_t i = chunk; i < 512; i++) buf[i] = 0;

        if (!blk_write_sector(s, buf)) return BKFS_EIO;
        in.blocks[blk_idx++] = s;
        written += chunk;
    }

    in.size = written;
    if (!inode_store(idx, &in)) return BKFS_EIO;
    return (int)written;
}

int bkfs_read(const char *name, void *buf, uint32_t max) {
    if (!g_ready) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint32_t idx;
    if (!inode_find(name, &idx)) return BKFS_ENOENT;

    bkfs_inode_t in;
    if (!inode_load(idx, &in)) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint32_t to_read = in.size;
    if (to_read > max) to_read = max;

    uint8_t sec[512];
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)buf;
    uint32_t got = 0;
    int blk = 0;

    while (got < to_read && blk < BKFS_BLOCKS_PER_FILE) {
        uint32_t s = in.blocks[blk];
        if (s == 0) break;
        if (!blk_read_sector(s, sec)) return BKFS_EIO;

        uint32_t chunk = to_read - got;
        if (chunk > 512) chunk = 512;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < chunk; i++) dst[got + i] = sec[i];
        got += chunk;
        blk++;
    }
    return (int)got;
}

int bkfs_delete(const char *name) {
    if (!g_ready) return BKFS_EIO;

    uint32_t idx;
    if (!inode_find(name, &idx)) return BKFS_ENOENT;

    bkfs_inode_t in;
    bytes_zero(&in, sizeof(in));
    in.type = 0;

    if (!inode_store(idx, &in)) return BKFS_EIO;
    return BKFS_OK;
}

int bkfs_list(int idx, char *name_out, uint32_t name_max, uint32_t *size_out) {
    if (!g_ready) return 0;

    int seen = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < BKFS_INODE_COUNT; i++) {
        if (!inode_load_sector(i)) return 0;
        bkfs_inode_t *p = inode_ptr(i);
        if (p->type == 0) continue;
        if (seen == idx) {
            str_copy_n(name_out, p->name, (int)name_max);
            if (size_out) *size_out = p->size;
            return 1;
        }
        seen++;
    }
    return 0;
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/desktop.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — desktop.c
// Иконки рабочего стола: Computer, Recycle, Terminal, Files, Editor.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "desktop.h"
#include "fb.h"
#include "icons.h"

#define FIRST_X   20
#define FIRST_Y   72
#define ICON_CELL 84
#define GAP_Y     6

static int g_selected = -1;

static const char *g_labels[DI_COUNT] = {
    "Computer",
    "Recycle",
    "Terminal",
    "Files",
    "Editor",
};

static int icon_y(int idx) {
    return FIRST_Y + idx * (ICON_CELL + GAP_Y);
}

int desktop_hit(int x, int y) {
    for (int i = 0; i < DI_COUNT; i++) {
        int ix = FIRST_X;
        int iy = icon_y(i);
        if (x >= ix && x < ix + ICON_CELL &&
            y >= iy && y < iy + ICON_CELL) return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

void desktop_select(int idx) { g_selected = idx; }
int  desktop_selected(void) { return g_selected; }
void desktop_clear_selection(void) { g_selected = -1; }

const char *desktop_label(int idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= DI_COUNT) return "";
    return g_labels[idx];
}

static int str_len(const char *s) { int n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }

static void draw_icon_at(int idx, int ix, int iy) {
    int sel = (idx == g_selected);

    // Рамка выделения — 2 px синяя.
    if (sel) {
        // Верх.
        fb_fill_rect(ix - 3, iy - 3, ICON_CELL + 6, 2, 0xFF4A90E2);
        // Низ.
        fb_fill_rect(ix - 3, iy + ICON_CELL + 1, ICON_CELL + 6, 2, 0xFF4A90E2);
        // Лево.
        fb_fill_rect(ix - 3, iy - 1, 2, ICON_CELL + 2, 0xFF4A90E2);
        // Право.
        fb_fill_rect(ix + ICON_CELL + 1, iy - 1, 2, ICON_CELL + 2, 0xFF4A90E2);
    }

    // Иконка 32×32 отцентрована в квадрате ICON_CELL.
    int ix_off = ix + (ICON_CELL - 32) / 2;
    int iy_off = iy + 8;

    switch (idx) {
        case DI_COMPUTER: icon_draw_computer(ix_off, iy_off, sel); break;
        case DI_RECYCLE:  icon_draw_recycle (ix_off, iy_off, sel); break;
        case DI_TERMINAL: icon_draw_ksh    (ix_off, iy_off, sel); break;
        case DI_FILES:    icon_draw_files  (ix_off, iy_off, sel); break;
        case DI_EDITOR:   icon_draw_editor (ix_off, iy_off, sel); break;
    }

    // Подпись. bg = 0 → прозрачный, смешиваем с фоном (обоями).
    const char *lbl = g_labels[idx];
    int lw = str_len(lbl) * 8;
    int lx = ix + (ICON_CELL - lw) / 2;
    int ly = iy + ICON_CELL - 18;

    uint32_t lbl_bg = sel ? 0xFF2A4A75 : 0;
    fb_draw_string_aa(lx, ly, lbl, 0xFFFFFFFF, lbl_bg);
}

void desktop_draw(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < DI_COUNT; i++) {
        draw_icon_at(i, FIRST_X, icon_y(i));
    }
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/files.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — files.c
// Простой файловый менеджер: список файлов BKFS, навигация стрелками,
// Delete удаляет выделенный, Enter "открывает" (пока просто статус).

#include <stdint.h>
#include "files.h"
#include "fb.h"
#include "bkfs.h"

#define CLR_BODY      0xFF101C2E
#define CLR_FG        0xFFE0E0E0
#define CLR_FG_DIM    0xFF9DA9B8
#define CLR_HEADER    0xFF15243A
#define CLR_HEADER_FG 0xFF7AB8FF
#define CLR_SELECT    0xFF4A90E2
#define CLR_SELECT_FG 0xFFFFFFFF
#define CLR_STATUS    0xFF2C4A73
#define CLR_STATUS_FG 0xFFF0F0F0
#define CLR_OK        0xFF6EE7A0
#define CLR_ERR       0xFFFF6B6B

static void str_copy_n(char *dst, const char *src, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    while (src[i] && i < max - 1) { dst[i] = src[i]; i++; }
    dst[i] = 0;
}

static int str_len(const char *s) { int n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }

void files_init(files_t *f) {
    f->count = 0;
    f->selected = 0;
    f->status_msg = 0;
    f->cursor_visible = 1;
    files_refresh(f);
}

void files_refresh(files_t *f) {
    f->count = 0;
    char fname[FILES_NAME_MAX];
    uint32_t fsize;
    for (int i = 0; bkfs_list(i, fname, FILES_NAME_MAX, &fsize); i++) {
        if (f->count >= FILES_MAX_ENTRIES) break;
        str_copy_n(f->names[f->count], fname, FILES_NAME_MAX);
        f->sizes[f->count] = fsize;
        f->count++;
    }
    if (f->selected >= f->count) f->selected = (f->count > 0) ? f->count - 1 : 0;
    if (f->selected < 0) f->selected = 0;
}

// Размер в человекочитаемом виде: "123 B", "1.2 KB".
static void fmt_size(uint32_t sz, char *out, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    if (sz < 1024) {
        char tmp[16]; int t = 0;
        if (sz == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
        while (sz) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (sz % 10)); sz /= 10; }
        while (t > 0 && i < max - 1) out[i++] = tmp[--t];
        if (i < max - 1) out[i++] = ' ';
        if (i < max - 1) out[i++] = 'B';
    } else {
        uint32_t kb = sz / 1024;
        char tmp[16]; int t = 0;
        if (kb == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
        while (kb) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (kb % 10)); kb /= 10; }
        while (t > 0 && i < max - 1) out[i++] = tmp[--t];
        if (i < max - 1) out[i++] = ' ';
        if (i < max - 1) out[i++] = 'K';
        if (i < max - 1) out[i++] = 'B';
    }
    out[i] = 0;
}

void files_draw_content(files_t *f, int cx, int cy, int cw, int ch) {
    fb_fill_rect(cx, cy, cw, ch, CLR_BODY);

    // Верхний header.
    fb_fill_rect(cx, cy, cw, 22, CLR_HEADER);
    fb_draw_string(cx + 8, cy + 7, "Name", CLR_HEADER_FG, CLR_HEADER);
    fb_draw_string(cx + cw - 80, cy + 7, "Size", CLR_HEADER_FG, CLR_HEADER);

    // Список записей.
    int row_h = 16;
    int top = cy + 26;
    int avail_rows = (ch - 26 - 22) / row_h;
    if (avail_rows < 1) avail_rows = 1;

    // Скроллинг: показываем окно вокруг selected.
    int first = 0;
    if (f->selected >= avail_rows) first = f->selected - avail_rows + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < avail_rows; i++) {
        int idx = first + i;
        if (idx >= f->count) break;

        int y = top + i * row_h;
        int is_sel = (idx == f->selected);
        uint32_t bg = is_sel ? CLR_SELECT : CLR_BODY;
        uint32_t fg = is_sel ? CLR_SELECT_FG : CLR_FG;

        if (is_sel) fb_fill_rect(cx + 2, y, cw - 4, row_h, bg);

        fb_draw_string(cx + 8, y + 4, f->names[idx], fg, bg);

        char szbuf[16];
        fmt_size(f->sizes[idx], szbuf, sizeof(szbuf));
        int sw = str_len(szbuf) * 8;
        fb_draw_string(cx + cw - 8 - sw, y + 4, szbuf,
                       is_sel ? CLR_SELECT_FG : CLR_FG_DIM, bg);
    }

    if (f->count == 0) {
        fb_draw_string(cx + 8, top + 4, "(no files)", CLR_FG_DIM, CLR_BODY);
    }

    // Статусная строка внизу.
    int sy = cy + ch - 20;
    fb_fill_rect(cx, sy, cw, 20, CLR_STATUS);
    char line[128];
    int i = 0;
    const char *pre = "Files: ";
    for (int j = 0; pre[j]; j++) line[i++] = pre[j];
    char tmp[16]; int t = 0;
    int cnt = f->count;
    if (cnt == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
    while (cnt) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (cnt % 10)); cnt /= 10; }
    while (t > 0) line[i++] = tmp[--t];
    const char *tail = " items    [Del] remove    [Enter] open";
    for (int j = 0; tail[j] && i < 120; j++) line[i++] = tail[j];
    line[i] = 0;
    fb_draw_string(cx + 8, sy + 6, line, CLR_STATUS_FG, CLR_STATUS);

    // Статус-сообщение.
    const char *right = 0;
    uint32_t rcol = CLR_STATUS_FG;
    if (f->status_msg == 1) { right = "deleted"; rcol = CLR_OK; }
    if (f->status_msg == 2) { right = "error";   rcol = CLR_ERR; }
    if (right) {
        int rlen = str_len(right);
        int rx = cx + cw - 8 - rlen * 8;
        fb_draw_string(rx, sy + 6, right, rcol, CLR_STATUS);
    }
}

void files_key(files_t *f, char c) {
    if (f->count == 0 && c != '\n') return;

    if (c == 0x11) {                    // UP
        if (f->selected > 0) f->selected--;
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x12) {                    // DOWN
        if (f->selected < f->count - 1) f->selected++;
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x15) { f->selected = 0; return; }
    if (c == 0x16) { f->selected = f->count > 0 ? f->count - 1 : 0; return; }

    if (c == 0x17) {                    // DEL
        if (f->selected >= 0 && f->selected < f->count) {
            int r = bkfs_delete(f->names[f->selected]);
            files_refresh(f);
            f->status_msg = (r == BKFS_OK) ? 1 : 2;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (c == '\n') {
        // "Открытие" пока не реализовано — просто статус ok.
        f->status_msg = 1;
        return;
    }
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/pci.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — pci.c
// Общие PCI helpers. Добавлен pci_find_device_nth.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "pci.h"

static inline void dsb_sy(void) { __asm__ volatile("dsb sy" ::: "memory"); }

static uint64_t cfg_addr(uint64_t ecam, int bus, int dev, int fn, uint32_t off) {
    return ecam
        + ((uint64_t)bus << 20)
        + ((uint64_t)dev << 15)
        + ((uint64_t)fn  << 12)
        + off;
}

uint32_t pci_cfg_read32(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off) {
    return *(volatile uint32_t *)cfg_addr(ecam, b, d, f, off);
}
uint16_t pci_cfg_read16(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off) {
    return *(volatile uint16_t *)cfg_addr(ecam, b, d, f, off);
}
uint8_t pci_cfg_read8(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off) {
    return *(volatile uint8_t *)cfg_addr(ecam, b, d, f, off);
}
void pci_cfg_write32(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off, uint32_t v) {
    *(volatile uint32_t *)cfg_addr(ecam, b, d, f, off) = v;
    dsb_sy();
}
void pci_cfg_write16(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off, uint16_t v) {
    *(volatile uint16_t *)cfg_addr(ecam, b, d, f, off) = v;
    dsb_sy();
}

int pci_find_device_nth(uint64_t ecam, uint16_t vendor, uint16_t device,
                        int skip, int *out_bus, int *out_dev, int *out_fn)
{
    int seen = 0;
    for (int bus = 0; bus < 4; bus++) {
        for (int dev = 0; dev < 32; dev++) {
            for (int fn = 0; fn < 8; fn++) {
                uint32_t id = pci_cfg_read32(ecam, bus, dev, fn, 0x00);
                if (id == 0 || id == 0xFFFFFFFFu) continue;
                uint16_t v = id & 0xFFFF;
                uint16_t d = (id >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
                if (v == vendor && d == device) {
                    if (seen == skip) {
                        *out_bus = bus; *out_dev = dev; *out_fn = fn;
                        return 1;
                    }
                    seen++;
                }
                uint8_t ht = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, bus, dev, fn, 0x0E);
                if (!(ht & 0x80)) break;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int pci_find_device(uint64_t ecam, uint16_t vendor, uint16_t device,
                    int *out_bus, int *out_dev, int *out_fn)
{
    return pci_find_device_nth(ecam, vendor, device, 0, out_bus, out_dev, out_fn);
}

void pci_assign_bar64(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f,
                      int bar_idx, uint64_t addr) {
    uint32_t old_lo = pci_cfg_read32(ecam, b, d, f, 0x10 + bar_idx * 4);
    uint32_t type_bits = old_lo & 0xF;
    uint32_t new_lo = ((uint32_t)addr & ~0xFull) | type_bits;
    uint32_t new_hi = (uint32_t)(addr >> 32);
    pci_cfg_write32(ecam, b, d, f, 0x10 + bar_idx * 4, new_lo);
    pci_cfg_write32(ecam, b, d, f, 0x10 + (bar_idx + 1) * 4, new_hi);
}

uint64_t pci_bar_base(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, int bar_idx) {
    uint32_t bar = pci_cfg_read32(ecam, b, d, f, 0x10 + bar_idx * 4);
    if (bar & 0x1) return (uint64_t)(bar & ~0x3u);
    uint32_t type = (bar >> 1) & 0x3;
    if (type == 0x2) {
        uint32_t bar_hi = pci_cfg_read32(ecam, b, d, f, 0x10 + (bar_idx + 1) * 4);
        return ((uint64_t)bar_hi << 32) | (bar & ~0xFull);
    }
    return (uint64_t)(bar & ~0xFull);
}

int pci_parse_virtio_caps(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, virtio_mmio_t *out) {
    out->common = 0; out->notify = 0; out->isr = 0; out->device = 0;
    out->notify_mult = 0;

    uint16_t cmd = pci_cfg_read16(ecam, b, d, f, 0x04);
    cmd |= 0x2 | 0x4;
    pci_cfg_write16(ecam, b, d, f, 0x04, cmd);

    uint8_t cap_ptr = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, b, d, f, 0x34) & 0xFC;

    while (cap_ptr != 0) {
        uint8_t cap_id = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr);
        if (cap_id == 0x09) {
            uint8_t cfg_type = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr + 3);
            uint8_t bar_idx  = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr + 4);
            uint32_t offset  = pci_cfg_read32(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr + 8);
            if (bar_idx > 5) { cap_ptr = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr + 1) & 0xFC; continue; }
            uint64_t abs = pci_bar_base(ecam, b, d, f, bar_idx) + offset;
            if (cfg_type == 1) out->common = abs;
            if (cfg_type == 2) { out->notify = abs; out->notify_mult = pci_cfg_read32(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr + 16); }
            if (cfg_type == 3) out->isr = abs;
            if (cfg_type == 4) out->device = abs;
        }
        cap_ptr = pci_cfg_read8(ecam, b, d, f, cap_ptr + 1) & 0xFC;
    }

    return (out->common && out->notify && out->isr && out->device);
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/initrd.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — initrd.c
// Разбор вкомпилированного образа. Формат — см. scripts/mkinitrd.py.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "initrd.h"

extern const uint8_t        initrd_data[];
extern const unsigned long  initrd_size;

static initrd_file_t g_files[INITRD_MAX_FILES];
static int           g_count = 0;

static uint32_t le32(const uint8_t *p) {
    return ((uint32_t)p[0]) | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 8) |
           ((uint32_t)p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24);
}

static int str_eq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) { if (*a++ != *b++) return 0; }
    return *a == '\0' && *b == '\0';
}

int initrd_init(void) {
    g_count = 0;

    if (initrd_size < 8) return 0;
    if (initrd_data[0] != 'B' || initrd_data[1] != 'K' ||
        initrd_data[2] != 'R' || initrd_data[3] != 'D') return 0;

    uint32_t num = le32(initrd_data + 4);
    if (num > INITRD_MAX_FILES) num = INITRD_MAX_FILES;

    const uint8_t *p   = initrd_data + 8;
    const uint8_t *end = initrd_data + initrd_size;

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < num; i++) {
        if (p + 36 > end) break;

        for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) g_files[i].name[j] = (char)p[j];
        g_files[i].name[31] = 0;

        uint32_t sz = le32(p + 32);
        p += 36;

        if (p + sz > end) break;

        g_files[i].size = sz;
        g_files[i].data = p;
        p += sz;

        g_count++;
    }

    return g_count;
}

int initrd_count(void) { return g_count; }

const initrd_file_t *initrd_get(int idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= g_count) return 0;
    return &g_files[idx];
}

const initrd_file_t *initrd_find(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++) {
        if (str_eq(g_files[i].name, name)) return &g_files[i];
    }
    return 0;
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/syscall.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — syscall.c
// Диспетчер syscall. Если задача помечена to_window, то write(1,...)
// уходит в ksh-буфер, откуда его читает окно.

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include "syscall.h"
#include "task.h"
#include "sched.h"
#include "initrd.h"
#include "ksh.h"

extern void uart_putc(char c);
extern void uart_puts(const char *s);
extern void uart_putu(uint64_t v);
extern int  uart_rx_pop(uint8_t *out);

#define MAX_OPEN 8
#define FD_BASE  3

typedef struct {
    int                  used;
    const initrd_file_t *file;
    uint32_t             offset;
} open_file_t;

static open_file_t g_open[MAX_OPEN];

static int fd_alloc(const initrd_file_t *f) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_OPEN; i++) {
        if (!g_open[i].used) {
            g_open[i].used   = 1;
            g_open[i].file   = f;
            g_open[i].offset = 0;
            return FD_BASE + i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

static open_file_t *fd_get(int fd) {
    if (fd < FD_BASE) return 0;
    int i = fd - FD_BASE;
    if (i < 0 || i >= MAX_OPEN) return 0;
    if (!g_open[i].used) return 0;
    return &g_open[i];
}

static void fd_release(int fd) {
    open_file_t *o = fd_get(fd);
    if (o) o->used = 0;
}

static uint64_t sys_write(int fd, const void *buf, size_t len) {
    if (fd != 1 && fd != 2) return (uint64_t)-1;

    task_t *cur = sched_current();
    if (cur && cur->to_window) {
        ksh_out_write((const char *)buf, (uint32_t)len);
        return len;
    }

    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)buf;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) uart_putc((char)p[i]);
    return len;
}

static uint64_t sys_read(int fd, void *buf, size_t len) {
    if (!buf || len == 0) return 0;

    if (fd == 0) {
        uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)buf;
        size_t got = 0;
        while (got < len) {
            uint8_t b;
            if (!uart_rx_pop(&b)) break;
            if (b == '\r') b = '\n';
            p[got++] = b;
            if (b == '\n') break;
        }
        return got;
    }

    open_file_t *o = fd_get(fd);
    if (!o) return (uint64_t)-1;

    uint32_t avail = o->file->size - o->offset;
    if (avail > len) avail = (uint32_t)len;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < avail; i++) {
        ((uint8_t *)buf)[i] = o->file->data[o->offset + i];
    }
    o->offset += avail;
    return avail;
}

static uint64_t sys_open(const char *name, int flags) {
    (void)flags;
    if (!name) return (uint64_t)-1;
    const initrd_file_t *f = initrd_find(name);
    if (!f) return (uint64_t)-1;
    return (uint64_t)fd_alloc(f);
}

static uint64_t sys_close(int fd) {
    if (fd < FD_BASE) return (uint64_t)-1;
    if (!fd_get(fd)) return (uint64_t)-1;
    fd_release(fd);
    return 0;
}

static void build_exit_msg(char *out, uint64_t code, int *len) {
    // "[exit N]\n"
    const char *pre = "[exit ";
    int i = 0;
    for (int j = 0; pre[j]; j++) out[i++] = pre[j];
    char tmp[16]; int t = 0;
    if (code == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
    while (code) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (code % 10)); code /= 10; }
    while (t > 0) out[i++] = tmp[--t];
    out[i++] = ']';
    out[i++] = '\n';
    *len = i;
}

static uint64_t do_exit(uint64_t code, uint64_t sp) {
    task_t *cur = sched_current();

    char msg[32];
    int  mlen = 0;
    build_exit_msg(msg, code, &mlen);

    if (cur && cur->to_window) {
        ksh_out_write(msg, (uint32_t)mlen);
        ksh_out_flush_partial();
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < mlen; i++) uart_putc(msg[i]);
    }

    if (cur) cur->state = TASK_DEAD;
    return sched_yield_from_frame(sp);
}

uint64_t syscall_dispatch(uint64_t sp) {
    uint64_t *f  = (uint64_t *)sp;
    uint64_t nr  = f[8];
    uint64_t a0  = f[0];
    uint64_t a1  = f[1];
    uint64_t a2  = f[2];

    if (nr == SYS_EXIT)  return do_exit(a0, sp);
    if (nr == SYS_YIELD) return sched_yield_from_frame(sp);

    uint64_t ret = (uint64_t)-1;
    if (nr == SYS_WRITE) ret = sys_write((int)a0, (const void *)a1, (size_t)a2);
    if (nr == SYS_READ)  ret = sys_read ((int)a0, (void *)a1,       (size_t)a2);
    if (nr == SYS_OPEN)  ret = sys_open ((const char *)a0, (int)a1);
    if (nr == SYS_CLOSE) ret = sys_close((int)a0);

    f[0] = ret;
    return sp;
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/wm.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — wm.c
// Оконный менеджер: скруглённые углы, мягкая тень, градиентный заголовок.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "wm.h"
#include "fb.h"

extern void uart_puts(const char *s);

#define TITLEBAR_H 28
#define BORDER_W   2
#define RESIZE_SIZE 14
#define MIN_W      200
#define MIN_H      120
#define RADIUS     8          // радиус скругления окна
#define TITLE_R    6          // радиус заголовка (внутри рамки)

#define CLR_BORDER      0xFF5AA0F0
#define CLR_BORDER_NF   0xFF3A5570
#define CLR_TITLE_TOP   0xFF3B6FB8     // верх градиента
#define CLR_TITLE_BOT   0xFF1F3F6F     // низ градиента
#define CLR_TITLE_NF    0xFF2A3F55
#define CLR_TITLE_FG    0xFFF0F0F0
#define CLR_BODY        0xFF1A2E4A
#define CLR_HANDLE      0xFF7AB8FF

static wnd_t g_wnd[WM_MAX];
static int   g_count = 0;

static void str_copy_n(char *dst, const char *src, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    while (src[i] && i < max - 1) { dst[i] = src[i]; i++; }
    dst[i] = 0;
}

void wm_init(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < WM_MAX; i++) {
        g_wnd[i].type = WND_NONE;
        g_wnd[i].z = 0;
        g_wnd[i].visible = 0;
        g_wnd[i].focused = 0;
    }
    g_count = 0;
}

int wm_create(wnd_type_t type, int x, int y, int w, int h, const char *title) {
    if (g_count >= WM_MAX) return -1;
    int idx = g_count++;
    g_wnd[idx].type = type;
    g_wnd[idx].x = x;
    g_wnd[idx].y = y;
    g_wnd[idx].w = w;
    g_wnd[idx].h = h;
    g_wnd[idx].z = idx;
    g_wnd[idx].visible = 1;
    g_wnd[idx].minimized = 0;
    g_wnd[idx].focused = 0;
    str_copy_n(g_wnd[idx].title, title, 40);
    return idx;
}

void wm_show(int idx, int show) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= g_count) return;
    g_wnd[idx].visible = show;
}

void wm_set_title(int idx, const char *title) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= g_count) return;
    str_copy_n(g_wnd[idx].title, title, 40);
}

void wm_raise(int idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= g_count) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++) g_wnd[i].focused = 0;
    int my_z = g_wnd[idx].z;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++) {
        if (i == idx) continue;
        if (g_wnd[i].z > my_z) g_wnd[i].z--;
    }
    g_wnd[idx].z = g_count - 1;
    g_wnd[idx].focused = 1;
    g_wnd[idx].visible = 1;
    g_wnd[idx].minimized = 0;
}

wnd_t *wm_focused(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++)
        if (g_wnd[i].focused) return &g_wnd[i];
    return 0;
}

wnd_t *wm_get(int idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= g_count) return 0;
    return &g_wnd[idx];
}

int wm_find_type(wnd_type_t type) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++)
        if (g_wnd[i].type == type) return i;
    return -1;
}

void wm_set_size(int idx, int w, int h) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= g_count) return;
    if (w < MIN_W) w = MIN_W;
    if (h < MIN_H) h = MIN_H;
    int max_w = 1280 - g_wnd[idx].x;
    int max_h = 800  - g_wnd[idx].y - 2;
    if (w > max_w) w = max_w;
    if (h > max_h) h = max_h;
    g_wnd[idx].w = w;
    g_wnd[idx].h = h;
}

// ---- Мягкая тень ----
// Рисует затемнение фона вокруг окна: 3 слоя, каждый меньше затемняет.
static void draw_soft_shadow(int x, int y, int w, int h) {
    // Внешний слой — самый бледный (ближе к фону).
    fb_darken_rect(x + 8, y + 8, w, h, 200);
    // Средний слой.
    fb_darken_rect(x + 6, y + 6, w, h, 170);
    // Внутренний слой — самый тёмный.
    fb_darken_rect(x + 4, y + 4, w, h, 140);
}

// ---- Отрисовка окна ----
static void draw_window_frame(wnd_t *w) {
    uint32_t bcol = w->focused ? CLR_BORDER : CLR_BORDER_NF;

    // Мягкая тень.
    draw_soft_shadow(w->x, w->y, w->w, w->h);

    // Внешняя рамка — скруглённая.
    fb_fill_round_rect_aa(w->x, w->y, w->w, w->h, RADIUS, bcol);

    // Тело окна (внутри рамки).
    int bx = w->x + BORDER_W;
    int by = w->y + BORDER_W;
    int bw = w->w - 2*BORDER_W;
    int bh = w->h - 2*BORDER_W;

    // Заголовок — скруглённый сверху.
    if (w->focused) {
        // Градиент: рисуем 2 полосы с градиентом внутри top-rounded rect.
        // Сначала заливаем top rect градиентом через полосы.
        for (int i = 0; i < TITLEBAR_H; i++) {
            uint32_t t = (uint32_t)i * 255 / (TITLEBAR_H - 1);
            uint32_t inv = 255 - t;
            uint32_t r = (((CLR_TITLE_TOP >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv + ((CLR_TITLE_BOT >> 16) & 0xFF) * t) / 255;
            uint32_t g = (((CLR_TITLE_TOP >> 8)  & 0xFF) * inv + ((CLR_TITLE_BOT >> 8)  & 0xFF) * t) / 255;
            uint32_t b = (( CLR_TITLE_TOP        & 0xFF) * inv + ( CLR_TITLE_BOT        & 0xFF) * t) / 255;
            uint32_t c = 0xFF000000u | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
            if (i == 0) {
                fb_fill_round_rect_top_aa(bx, by, bw, TITLEBAR_H, TITLE_R, c);
                break;  // Дальше рисуем остальные строки поверх.
            }
        }
        // Теперь полосами перекрываем сверху — но только в границах top-rounded.
        // Проще: нарисовали верх, теперь строчками заливаем остальное с 0 по TITLE_R.
        for (int i = 0; i < TITLEBAR_H; i++) {
            uint32_t t = (uint32_t)i * 255 / (TITLEBAR_H - 1);
            uint32_t inv = 255 - t;
            uint32_t r = (((CLR_TITLE_TOP >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv + ((CLR_TITLE_BOT >> 16) & 0xFF) * t) / 255;
            uint32_t g = (((CLR_TITLE_TOP >> 8)  & 0xFF) * inv + ((CLR_TITLE_BOT >> 8)  & 0xFF) * t) / 255;
            uint32_t b = (( CLR_TITLE_TOP        & 0xFF) * inv + ( CLR_TITLE_BOT        & 0xFF) * t) / 255;
            uint32_t c = 0xFF000000u | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
            if (i >= TITLE_R) {
                fb_fill_rect(bx + TITLE_R, by + i, bw - 2*TITLE_R, 1, c);
            } else {
                // Левый и правый крайние пиксели — перезаписываем
                // (уже корректно нарисовано в top-rounded, но пусть)
            }
        }
    } else {
        fb_fill_round_rect_top_aa(bx, by, bw, TITLEBAR_H, TITLE_R, CLR_TITLE_NF);
    }

    // Тело под заголовком — нижние углы скруглены.
    fb_fill_round_rect_bot_aa(bx, by + TITLEBAR_H,
                              bw, bh - TITLEBAR_H,
                              TITLE_R, CLR_BODY);

    // Текст заголовка.
    fb_draw_string_aa(w->x + 12, w->y + 6, w->title, CLR_TITLE_FG,
                      w->focused ? CLR_TITLE_TOP : CLR_TITLE_NF);

    // Кнопки-кружки.
    int bx_ = w->x + w->w - 20;
    int by_ = w->y + 10;
    fb_fill_circle_aa(bx_ + 5,      by_ + 5, 5, 0xFFFF5F57);
    fb_fill_circle_aa(bx_ - 16 + 5, by_ + 5, 5, 0xFFFFBD2E);
    fb_fill_circle_aa(bx_ - 32 + 5, by_ + 5, 5, 0xFF28C840);
}

static int z_order_next(int prev_z, int *out_idx) {
    int best_z = 1000;
    int best_i = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++) {
        if (!g_wnd[i].visible) continue;
        if (g_wnd[i].z <= prev_z) continue;
        if (g_wnd[i].z < best_z) { best_z = g_wnd[i].z; best_i = i; }
    }
    *out_idx = best_i;
    return best_z;
}

void wm_draw_all(wm_draw_content_fn draw_content) {
    int prev_z = -1;
    int idx = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < g_count; k++) {
        int z = z_order_next(prev_z, &idx);
        if (idx < 0) return;
        prev_z = z;

        wnd_t *w = &g_wnd[idx];
        if (!w->visible) continue;

        draw_window_frame(w);

        // Content рисуем только в прямоугольник внутренней области.
        int cx = w->x + 4;
        int cy = w->y + TITLEBAR_H + 4;
        int cw = w->w - 8;
        int ch = w->h - TITLEBAR_H - 8;
        if (draw_content) draw_content(w->type, cx, cy, cw, ch);

        // Ручка ресайза — три диагональных штриха в правом нижнем углу.
        int hx = w->x + w->w - RESIZE_SIZE;
        int hy = w->y + w->h - RESIZE_SIZE;
        uint32_t hcol = w->focused ? CLR_HANDLE : 0xFF6A7A8A;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int off = 2 + i * 4;
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                fb_putpixel(hx + RESIZE_SIZE - 1 - off - j,
                            hy + RESIZE_SIZE - 1 - j, hcol);
            }
        }
    }
}

int wm_hit_test(int x, int y) {
    int best_z = -1;
    int best_i = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++) {
        wnd_t *w = &g_wnd[i];
        if (!w->visible || w->minimized) continue;
        if (x >= w->x && x < w->x + w->w &&
            y >= w->y && y < w->y + w->h) {
            if (w->z > best_z) { best_z = w->z; best_i = i; }
        }
    }
    return best_i;
}

int wm_hit_title(int x, int y) {
    int i = wm_hit_test(x, y);
    if (i < 0) return -1;
    wnd_t *w = &g_wnd[i];
    if (y >= w->y && y < w->y + TITLEBAR_H) return i;
    return -1;
}

int wm_hit_close(int x, int y) {
    int i = wm_hit_title(x, y);
    if (i < 0) return -1;
    wnd_t *w = &g_wnd[i];
    int bx = w->x + w->w - 20;
    int by = w->y + 10;
    if (x >= bx && x < bx + 10 && y >= by && y < by + 10) return i;
    return -1;
}

int wm_hit_resize(int x, int y) {
    int best_z = -1;
    int best_i = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_count; i++) {
        wnd_t *w = &g_wnd[i];
        if (!w->visible || w->minimized) continue;
        int rx = w->x + w->w - RESIZE_SIZE;
        int ry = w->y + w->h - RESIZE_SIZE;
        if (x >= rx && x < w->x + w->w &&
            y >= ry && y < w->y + w->h) {
            if (w->z > best_z) { best_z = w->z; best_i = i; }
        }
    }
    return best_i;
}
=== END OF FILE ===


=== START OF FILE: ./src/win.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — win.c
// ksh: контент без рамки. Команда wallpaper меняет обои.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "win.h"
#include "fb.h"
#include "initrd.h"
#include "ksh.h"
#include "bkfs.h"
#include "wallpaper.h"

extern void kwin_cmd_help(win_t *w);
extern void kwin_cmd_ver(win_t *w);
extern void kwin_cmd_tasks(win_t *w);
extern void kwin_cmd_mem(win_t *w);

extern int      ksh_launch_program(const char *name);
extern uint64_t blk_capacity(void);
extern int      ksh_request_edit(const char *name);
extern void     request_full_redraw(void);

#define CLR_BODY      0xFF1A2E4A
#define CLR_FG        0xFFE0E0E0
#define CLR_PROMPT    0xFF7AB8FF
#define CLR_INPUT_BG  0xFF15243A
#define CLR_CURSOR    0xFF7AB8FF

static void str_copy(char *dst, const char *src, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    while (src[i] && i < max - 1) { dst[i] = src[i]; i++; }
    dst[i] = 0;
}
static int str_len(const char *s) { int n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }
static int str_eq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) { if (*a++ != *b++) return 0; }
    return *a == 0 && *b == 0;
}

void win_init(win_t *w) {
    w->history_count = 0;
    w->input_len = 0;
    w->input[0] = 0;
    w->cursor_pos = 0;
    w->cmd_history_count = 0;
    w->cmd_history_idx = -1;
    w->cursor_visible = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < WIN_HISTORY_MAX; i++) w->history[i][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < WIN_CMD_HISTORY; i++) w->cmd_history[i][0] = 0;
}

void win_puts(win_t *w, const char *s) {
    if (w->history_count < WIN_HISTORY_MAX) {
        str_copy(w->history[w->history_count], s, WIN_LINE_MAX);
        w->history_count++;
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < WIN_HISTORY_MAX; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < WIN_LINE_MAX; j++) {
            w->history[i - 1][j] = w->history[i][j];
        }
    }
    str_copy(w->history[WIN_HISTORY_MAX - 1], s, WIN_LINE_MAX);
}

void win_draw_content(win_t *w, int cx, int cy, int cw, int ch) {
    fb_fill_rect(cx, cy, cw, ch, CLR_BODY);

    int line_h = 12;
    int input_h = 30;
    int visible_rows = (ch - input_h - 6) / line_h;
    int start = 0;
    if (w->history_count > visible_rows) start = w->history_count - visible_rows;

    int ty = cy + 4;
    for (int i = start; i < w->history_count; i++) {
        fb_draw_string(cx + 8, ty, w->history[i], CLR_FG, CLR_BODY);
        ty += line_h;
    }

    int iy = cy + ch - input_h - 2;
    fb_fill_rect(cx + 2, iy, cw - 4, input_h, CLR_INPUT_BG);
    fb_draw_string(cx + 12, iy + 11, "ksh$", CLR_PROMPT, CLR_INPUT_BG);
    fb_draw_string(cx + 44, iy + 11, w->input, CLR_FG, CLR_INPUT_BG);

    if (w->cursor_visible) {
        int px = cx + 44 + w->cursor_pos * 8;
        fb_fill_rect(px, iy + 11, 8, 10, CLR_CURSOR);
        if (w->cursor_pos < w->input_len) {
            char c = w->input[w->cursor_pos];
            fb_draw_char(px, iy + 11, c, CLR_INPUT_BG, CLR_CURSOR);
        }
    }
}

// ---- Tab completion ----
static void tab_complete(win_t *w) {
    static const char *cmds[] = {
        "help", "ver", "tasks", "mem", "disk",
        "mkfs", "lsw", "touch", "write", "rm",
        "edit", "wallpaper",
        "echo", "clear", "ls", "cat", "motd", "hexdump", "run", 0
    };

    int sp = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < w->input_len; i++) {
        if (w->input[i] == ' ') { sp = i; break; }
    }

    if (sp < 0) {
        for (int i = 0; cmds[i]; i++) {
            const char *c = cmds[i];
            int k = 0;
            while (c[k] && w->input[k] && c[k] == w->input[k]) k++;
            if (k == w->input_len) {
                int L = str_len(c);
                for (int j = w->input_len; j < L; j++) w->input[j] = c[j];
                w->input[L] = ' ';
                w->input[L + 1] = 0;
                w->input_len = L + 1;
                w->cursor_pos = w->input_len;
                return;
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // Автодополнение имени обоев после "wallpaper ".
    if (sp == 9 && w->input[0] == 'w' && w->input[1] == 'a') {
        const char *prefix = w->input + 10;
        int plen = str_len(prefix);
        int n = wallpaper_count();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const char *name = wallpaper_name(i);
            int k = 0;
            while (name[k] && prefix[k] && name[k] == prefix[k]) k++;
            if (k == plen) {
                int L = str_len(name);
                for (int j = plen; j < L; j++) w->input[10 + j] = name[j];
                w->input[10 + L] = 0;
                w->input_len = 10 + L;
                w->cursor_pos = w->input_len;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // Автодополнение имени файла BKFS.
    const char *prefix = w->input + sp + 1;
    int plen = str_len(prefix);
    char fname[64];
    uint32_t fsize;
    for (int i = 0; bkfs_list(i, fname, sizeof(fname), &fsize); i++) {
        int k = 0;
        while (fname[k] && prefix[k] && fname[k] == prefix[k]) k++;
        if (k == plen) {
            int L = str_len(fname);
            for (int j = plen; j < L; j++) w->input[sp + 1 + j] = fname[j];
            w->input[sp + 1 + L] = 0;
            w->input_len = sp + 1 + L;
            w->cursor_pos = w->input_len;
            return;
        }
    }
}

static int str_eq_prefix(const char *s, const char *prefix) {
    while (*prefix) { if (*s++ != *prefix++) return 0; }
    return 1;
}

static void print_initrd_file(win_t *w, const char *name) {
    const initrd_file_t *f = initrd_find(name);
    if (!f) { win_puts(w, "no such file"); return; }
    char line[WIN_LINE_MAX];
    int  li = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < f->size; i++) {
        char c = (char)f->data[i];
        if (c == '\r') continue;
        if (c == '\n') { line[li] = 0; win_puts(w, line); li = 0; continue; }
        if (li < WIN_LINE_MAX - 1) line[li++] = c;
    }
    if (li > 0) { line[li] = 0; win_puts(w, line); }
}

static void print_bkfs_file(win_t *w, const char *name) {
    static uint8_t buf[8192];
    int n = bkfs_read(name, buf, sizeof(buf));
    if (n == BKFS_ENOENT) { win_puts(w, "no such file"); return; }
    if (n < 0) { win_puts(w, "read error"); return; }

    char line[WIN_LINE_MAX];
    int  li = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = (char)buf[i];
        if (c == '\r') continue;
        if (c == '\n') { line[li] = 0; win_puts(w, line); li = 0; continue; }
        if (li < WIN_LINE_MAX - 1) line[li++] = c;
    }
    if (li > 0) { line[li] = 0; win_puts(w, line); }
}

static void push_cmd_history(win_t *w, const char *cmd) {
    if (!cmd[0]) return;
    if (w->cmd_history_count > 0) {
        int last = (w->cmd_history_count - 1) % WIN_CMD_HISTORY;
        if (str_eq(w->cmd_history[last], cmd)) return;
    }
    int idx = w->cmd_history_count % WIN_CMD_HISTORY;
    str_copy(w->cmd_history[idx], cmd, WIN_INPUT_MAX + 1);
    w->cmd_history_count++;
}

static const char *get_cmd_history(win_t *w, int back) {
    if (back >= w->cmd_history_count) return 0;
    int idx = (w->cmd_history_count - 1 - back) % WIN_CMD_HISTORY;
    return w->cmd_history[idx];
}

static void print_bkfs_list(win_t *w) {
    char fname[64];
    uint32_t fsize;
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; bkfs_list(i, fname, sizeof(fname), &fsize); i++) {
        char buf[WIN_LINE_MAX];
        int bi = 0;
        for (int j = 0; fname[j] && bi < WIN_LINE_MAX - 20; j++) buf[bi++] = fname[j];
        while (bi < 20) buf[bi++] = ' ';
        char tmp[16]; int t = 0;
        uint32_t sz = fsize;
        if (sz == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
        while (sz) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (sz % 10)); sz /= 10; }
        while (t > 0) buf[bi++] = tmp[--t];
        const char *tail = " bytes";
        for (int j = 0; tail[j]; j++) buf[bi++] = tail[j];
        buf[bi] = 0;
        win_puts(w, buf);
        n++;
    }
    if (n == 0) win_puts(w, "(no files)");
}

static void exec_cmd(win_t *w, const char *cmd) {
    char line[WIN_LINE_MAX];
    int i = 0;
    const char *pre = "ksh$ ";
    for (int j = 0; pre[j]; j++) line[i++] = pre[j];
    for (int j = 0; cmd[j] && i < WIN_LINE_MAX - 1; j++) line[i++] = cmd[j];
    line[i] = 0;
    win_puts(w, line);

    if (!cmd[0]) return;

    if (str_eq(cmd, "help"))  { kwin_cmd_help(w); return; }
    if (str_eq(cmd, "ver"))   { kwin_cmd_ver(w); return; }
    if (str_eq(cmd, "tasks")) { kwin_cmd_tasks(w); return; }
    if (str_eq(cmd, "mem"))   { kwin_cmd_mem(w); return; }
    if (str_eq(cmd, "clear")) { w->history_count = 0; return; }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "disk")) {
        uint64_t cap = blk_capacity();
        char buf[64];
        int k = 0;
        const char *p = "capacity: ";
        for (int j = 0; p[j]; j++) buf[k++] = p[j];
        char tmp[24]; int t = 0;
        if (cap == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
        while (cap) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (cap % 10)); cap /= 10; }
        while (t > 0) buf[k++] = tmp[--t];
        const char *tail = " sectors";
        for (int j = 0; tail[j]; j++) buf[k++] = tail[j];
        buf[k] = 0;
        win_puts(w, buf);
        return;
    }

    // ---- wallpaper ----
    if (str_eq(cmd, "wallpaper")) {
        win_puts(w, "Available wallpapers:");
        int n = wallpaper_count();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char buf[40];
            buf[0] = ' ';
            buf[1] = ' ';
            int k = 2;
            const char *name = wallpaper_name(i);
            for (int j = 0; name[j] && k < 38; j++) buf[k++] = name[j];
            buf[k] = 0;
            win_puts(w, buf);
        }
        win_puts(w, "usage: wallpaper <name>");
        return;
    }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "wallpaper ")) {
        const char *name = cmd + 10;
        if (wallpaper_set_by_name(name)) {
            win_puts(w, "wallpaper changed");
            request_full_redraw();
        } else {
            win_puts(w, "unknown wallpaper");
        }
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "mkfs")) {
        int r = bkfs_format();
        win_puts(w, r == BKFS_OK ? "formatted" : "format failed");
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "lsw")) {
        if (!bkfs_is_ready()) { win_puts(w, "no filesystem (run mkfs)"); return; }
        print_bkfs_list(w);
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "touch")) { win_puts(w, "usage: touch <name>"); return; }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "touch ")) {
        if (!bkfs_is_ready()) { win_puts(w, "no filesystem"); return; }
        int r = bkfs_create(cmd + 6);
        if (r == BKFS_OK) win_puts(w, "created");
        else if (r == BKFS_EEXIST) win_puts(w, "already exists");
        else win_puts(w, "error");
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "write")) { win_puts(w, "usage: write <name> <text>"); return; }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "write ")) {
        if (!bkfs_is_ready()) { win_puts(w, "no filesystem"); return; }
        const char *arg = cmd + 6;
        int sp = -1;
        for (int j = 0; arg[j]; j++) { if (arg[j] == ' ') { sp = j; break; } }
        if (sp <= 0) { win_puts(w, "usage: write <name> <text>"); return; }

        char name[64];
        for (int j = 0; j < sp && j < 63; j++) name[j] = arg[j];
        name[sp] = 0;

        const char *text = arg + sp + 1;
        uint32_t tlen = (uint32_t)str_len(text);

        int r = bkfs_create(name);
        if (r == BKFS_EEXIST) r = BKFS_OK;
        if (r != BKFS_OK) { win_puts(w, "create failed"); return; }
        int w_len = bkfs_write(name, text, tlen);
        if (w_len < 0) { win_puts(w, "write failed"); return; }
        win_puts(w, "written");
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "rm")) { win_puts(w, "usage: rm <name>"); return; }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "rm ")) {
        if (!bkfs_is_ready()) { win_puts(w, "no filesystem"); return; }
        int r = bkfs_delete(cmd + 3);
        if (r == BKFS_OK) win_puts(w, "removed");
        else if (r == BKFS_ENOENT) win_puts(w, "no such file");
        else win_puts(w, "error");
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "edit")) { win_puts(w, "usage: edit <file>"); return; }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "edit ")) {
        if (!bkfs_is_ready()) { win_puts(w, "no filesystem"); return; }
        const char *name = cmd + 5;
        if (ksh_request_edit(name)) win_puts(w, "editor opened");
        else win_puts(w, "cannot open editor");
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "echo ")) { win_puts(w, cmd + 5); return; }
    if (str_eq(cmd, "echo")) { win_puts(w, ""); return; }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "ls")) {
        win_puts(w, "--- initrd ---");
        int n = initrd_count();
        if (n == 0) win_puts(w, "(empty)");
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            const initrd_file_t *f = initrd_get(k);
            if (!f) continue;
            char buf[WIN_LINE_MAX];
            int bi = 0;
            for (int j = 0; f->name[j] && bi < WIN_LINE_MAX - 20; j++) buf[bi++] = f->name[j];
            while (bi < 20) buf[bi++] = ' ';
            char tmp[16]; int t = 0;
            uint32_t sz = f->size;
            if (sz == 0) tmp[t++] = '0';
            while (sz) { tmp[t++] = (char)('0' + (sz % 10)); sz /= 10; }
            while (t > 0) buf[bi++] = tmp[--t];
            const char *tail = " bytes";
            for (int j = 0; tail[j]; j++) buf[bi++] = tail[j];
            buf[bi] = 0;
            win_puts(w, buf);
        }
        if (bkfs_is_ready()) {
            win_puts(w, "--- disk (BKFS) ---");
            print_bkfs_list(w);
        } else {
            win_puts(w, "--- disk: not formatted ---");
        }
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "motd")) { print_initrd_file(w, "motd.txt"); return; }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "cat")) { win_puts(w, "usage: cat <file>"); return; }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "cat ")) {
        const char *name = cmd + 4;
        if (bkfs_is_ready()) {
            static uint8_t tmpbuf[8];
            int r = bkfs_read(name, tmpbuf, 0);
            if (r != BKFS_ENOENT) { print_bkfs_file(w, name); return; }
        }
        print_initrd_file(w, name);
        return;
    }

    if (str_eq(cmd, "run")) { win_puts(w, "usage: run <prog>  (progs: cat)"); return; }
    if (str_eq_prefix(cmd, "run ")) {
        const char *prog = cmd + 4;
        int ok = ksh_launch_program(prog);
        if (!ok) win_puts(w, "unknown program");
        return;
    }

    win_puts(w, "unknown command. type 'help'.");
}

void win_key(win_t *w, char c) {
    if (c == 0x11) {
        const char *cmd = get_cmd_history(w, w->cmd_history_idx + 1);
        if (cmd) {
            w->cmd_history_idx++;
            str_copy(w->input, cmd, WIN_INPUT_MAX + 1);
            w->input_len = str_len(w->input);
            w->cursor_pos = w->input_len;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x12) {
        if (w->cmd_history_idx > 0) {
            w->cmd_history_idx--;
            const char *cmd = get_cmd_history(w, w->cmd_history_idx);
            if (cmd) {
                str_copy(w->input, cmd, WIN_INPUT_MAX + 1);
                w->input_len = str_len(w->input);
                w->cursor_pos = w->input_len;
            }
        } else if (w->cmd_history_idx == 0) {
            w->cmd_history_idx = -1;
            w->input[0] = 0;
            w->input_len = 0;
            w->cursor_pos = 0;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x13) { if (w->cursor_pos > 0) w->cursor_pos--; return; }
    if (c == 0x14) { if (w->cursor_pos < w->input_len) w->cursor_pos++; return; }
    if (c == 0x15) { w->cursor_pos = 0; return; }
    if (c == 0x16) { w->cursor_pos = w->input_len; return; }
    if (c == 0x17) {
        if (w->cursor_pos < w->input_len) {
            for (int i = w->cursor_pos; i < w->input_len - 1; i++)
                w->input[i] = w->input[i + 1];
            w->input_len--;
            w->input[w->input_len] = 0;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (c == '\b') {
        if (w->cursor_pos > 0) {
            for (int i = w->cursor_pos - 1; i < w->input_len - 1; i++)
                w->input[i] = w->input[i + 1];
            w->input_len--;
            w->input[w->input_len] = 0;
            w->cursor_pos--;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == '\t') { tab_complete(w); return; }
    if (c == '\n') {
        w->input[w->input_len] = 0;
        push_cmd_history(w, w->input);
        w->cmd_history_idx = -1;
        exec_cmd(w, w->input);
        w->input_len = 0;
        w->cursor_pos = 0;
        w->input[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if ((unsigned char)c < 0x20) return;
    if (w->input_len < WIN_INPUT_MAX) {
        for (int i = w->input_len; i > w->cursor_pos; i--)
            w->input[i] = w->input[i - 1];
        w->input[w->cursor_pos] = c;
        w->input_len++;
        w->input[w->input_len] = 0;
        w->cursor_pos++;
    }
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/task.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — task.c
// Создание задач. Добавлено поле to_window.

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include "task.h"
#include "heap.h"
#include "physmem.h"
#include "mmu.h"

#define FRAME_SIZE 0x120

#define SPSR_EL1H_UNMASKED 0x5ull
#define SPSR_EL0T_UNMASKED 0x0ull

static uint64_t g_next_id = 1;

static void copy_name(task_t *t, const char *name) {
    int i = 0;
    if (name) {
        while (name[i] && i < TASK_NAME_MAX - 1) {
            t->name[i] = name[i];
            i++;
        }
    }
    t->name[i] = '\0';
}

task_t *task_create(const char *name, void (*fn)(void)) {
    task_t *t = (task_t *)kmalloc(sizeof(task_t));
    if (!t) return 0;

    uint64_t pages = (TASK_STACK_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE;
    uint8_t *kstack = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_pages(pages);
    if (!kstack) { kfree(t); return 0; }

    copy_name(t, name);
    t->id         = g_next_id++;
    t->state      = TASK_READY;
    t->next       = 0;
    t->to_window  = 0;

    uint64_t kstack_top = (uint64_t)(kstack + pages * PAGE_SIZE);
    uint64_t frame_sp   = (kstack_top - FRAME_SIZE) & ~0xFull;

    uint64_t *f = (uint64_t *)frame_sp;
    for (int k = 0; k < (int)(FRAME_SIZE / 8); k++) f[k] = 0;

    f[0x100 / 8] = (uint64_t)fn;
    f[0x108 / 8] = SPSR_EL1H_UNMASKED;

    t->sp_saved = frame_sp;
    return t;
}

task_t *task_create_user(const char *name, const void *code, unsigned long code_size) {
    task_t *t = (task_t *)kmalloc(sizeof(task_t));
    if (!t) return 0;

    uint64_t kpages = (TASK_STACK_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE - 1) / PAGE_SIZE;
    uint8_t *kstack = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_pages(kpages);
    if (!kstack) { kfree(t); return 0; }

    uint8_t *code_page = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    if (!code_page) { kfree(t); return 0; }

    uint8_t *ustack = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    if (!ustack) { kfree(t); return 0; }

    if (code_size > PAGE_SIZE) code_size = PAGE_SIZE;
    for (unsigned long i = 0; i < code_size; i++) code_page[i] = ((const uint8_t *)code)[i];

    mmu_user_map_page((uint64_t)code_page, 1);
    mmu_user_map_page((uint64_t)ustack,    0);

    copy_name(t, name);
    t->id         = g_next_id++;
    t->state      = TASK_READY;
    t->next       = 0;
    t->to_window  = 0;

    uint64_t kstack_top = (uint64_t)(kstack + kpages * PAGE_SIZE);
    uint64_t frame_sp   = (kstack_top - FRAME_SIZE) & ~0xFull;
    uint64_t ustack_top = (uint64_t)(ustack + PAGE_SIZE) & ~0xFull;

    uint64_t *f = (uint64_t *)frame_sp;
    for (int k = 0; k < (int)(FRAME_SIZE / 8); k++) f[k] = 0;

    f[0x100 / 8] = (uint64_t)code_page;
    f[0x108 / 8] = SPSR_EL0T_UNMASKED;
    f[0x110 / 8] = ustack_top;

    t->sp_saved = frame_sp;
    return t;
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/virtio.h ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — virtio.h
#ifndef BKOS_VIRTIO_H
#define BKOS_VIRTIO_H

#include <stdint.h>

#define VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1       (1ull << 32)

// QEMU virtio-gpu control queue даёт max 64 дескриптора.
#define VIRTQ_SIZE 64

// Флаги дескрипторов virtqueue.
#define VIRTQ_DESC_F_NEXT   0x1
#define VIRTQ_DESC_F_WRITE  0x2

typedef struct {
    uint64_t common;
    uint64_t notify;
    uint64_t isr;
    uint64_t device;
    uint32_t notify_mult;
} virtio_mmio_t;

typedef struct {
    int      ok;
    uint64_t device_features;
    uint64_t driver_features;
    uint16_t num_queues;
    uint8_t  status;
} virtio_state_t;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint64_t addr;
    uint32_t len;
    uint16_t flags;
    uint16_t next;
} virtq_desc_t;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t flags;
    uint16_t idx;
    uint16_t ring[VIRTQ_SIZE];
    uint16_t used_event;
} virtq_avail_t;

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t flags;
    uint16_t idx;
    struct __attribute__((packed)) {
        uint32_t id;
        uint32_t len;
    } ring[VIRTQ_SIZE];
    uint16_t avail_event;
} virtq_used_t;

typedef struct {
    uint16_t         queue_index;
    uint16_t         queue_size;
    virtq_desc_t    *desc;
    virtq_avail_t   *avail;
    virtq_used_t    *used;
    uint64_t         desc_phys;
    uint64_t         avail_phys;
    uint64_t         used_phys;
    uint16_t         notify_off;
} virtqueue_t;

int virtio_transport_init(const virtio_mmio_t *io, virtio_state_t *out);
int virtio_set_features(const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint64_t features, virtio_state_t *out);
int virtio_setup_queue(const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint16_t qidx, virtqueue_t *vq);
int virtio_activate(const virtio_mmio_t *io, virtio_state_t *st);

uint8_t  virtio_common_read8 (const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint32_t off);
uint16_t virtio_common_read16(const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint32_t off);
uint32_t virtio_common_read32(const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint32_t off);
void     virtio_common_write8 (const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint32_t off, uint8_t  v);
void     virtio_common_write16(const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint32_t off, uint16_t v);
void     virtio_common_write32(const virtio_mmio_t *io, uint32_t off, uint32_t v);

void virtio_queue_notify(const virtio_mmio_t *io, const virtqueue_t *vq);

#endif

=== START OF FILE: ./src/_start.s ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — boot stub + vectors + jump_to_frame.
// Фрейм: 0x120 байт (x0..x30, ELR, SPSR, SP_EL0).

.section .text
.global _start
.global exception_vectors
.global jump_to_frame
.extern kernel_main
.extern exception_sync_handler
.extern irq_handler
.extern mmu_init

.macro VEC target
    b   \target
    .balign 0x80
.endm

.macro SAVE_FULL_FRAME
    sub sp, sp, #0x120
    stp x0,  x1,  [sp, #0x00]
    stp x2,  x3,  [sp, #0x10]
    stp x4,  x5,  [sp, #0x20]
    stp x6,  x7,  [sp, #0x30]
    stp x8,  x9,  [sp, #0x40]
    stp x10, x11, [sp, #0x50]
    stp x12, x13, [sp, #0x60]
    stp x14, x15, [sp, #0x70]
    stp x16, x17, [sp, #0x80]
    stp x18, x19, [sp, #0x90]
    stp x20, x21, [sp, #0xA0]
    stp x22, x23, [sp, #0xB0]
    stp x24, x25, [sp, #0xC0]
    stp x26, x27, [sp, #0xD0]
    stp x28, x29, [sp, #0xE0]
    str x30,      [sp, #0xF0]
    mrs x0, elr_el1
    mrs x1, spsr_el1
    stp x0, x1,   [sp, #0x100]
    mrs x0, sp_el0
    str x0,       [sp, #0x110]
.endm

.macro RESTORE_FULL_FRAME
    ldr x0,       [sp, #0x110]
    msr sp_el0, x0
    ldp x0, x1,   [sp, #0x100]
    msr elr_el1, x0
    msr spsr_el1, x1
    ldr x30,      [sp, #0xF0]
    ldp x28, x29, [sp, #0xE0]
    ldp x26, x27, [sp, #0xD0]
    ldp x24, x25, [sp, #0xC0]
    ldp x22, x23, [sp, #0xB0]
    ldp x20, x21, [sp, #0xA0]
    ldp x18, x19, [sp, #0x90]
    ldp x16, x17, [sp, #0x80]
    ldp x14, x15, [sp, #0x70]
    ldp x12, x13, [sp, #0x60]
    ldp x10, x11, [sp, #0x50]
    ldp x8,  x9,  [sp, #0x40]
    ldp x6,  x7,  [sp, #0x30]
    ldp x4,  x5,  [sp, #0x20]
    ldp x2,  x3,  [sp, #0x10]
    ldp x0,  x1,  [sp, #0x00]
    add sp, sp, #0x120
.endm

_start:
    mov x19, x0

    mrs x0, CurrentEL
    lsr x0, x0, #2
    cmp x0, #2
    b.lt el1_entry

    mov x0, #0x80000000
    msr hcr_el2, x0
    mov x0, #3
    msr cnthctl_el2, x0
    mov x0, #0x3C5
    msr spsr_el2, x0
    adr x0, el1_entry
    msr elr_el2, x0
    isb
    eret

el1_entry:
    ldr x0, =stack_top
    mov sp, x0

    ldr x0, =__bss_start
    ldr x1, =__bss_end
    mov x2, #0
1:  cmp x0, x1
    b.hs 2f
    str x2, [x0], #8
    b 1b
2:

    ldr x0, =exception_vectors
    msr vbar_el1, x0
    isb

    bl mmu_init

    mov x0, x19
    bl kernel_main

hang:
    dsb sy
    wfe
    b hang

.p2align 11
exception_vectors:
    VEC vec_sync
    VEC vec_irq
    VEC vec_fiq
    VEC vec_serror
    VEC vec_sync
    VEC vec_irq
    VEC vec_fiq
    VEC vec_serror
    VEC vec_sync
    VEC vec_irq
    VEC vec_fiq
    VEC vec_serror
    VEC vec_sync
    VEC vec_irq
    VEC vec_fiq
    VEC vec_serror

vec_sync:
    SAVE_FULL_FRAME
    mov x0, sp
    bl exception_sync_handler
    mov sp, x0
    RESTORE_FULL_FRAME
    eret

vec_irq:
    SAVE_FULL_FRAME
    mov x0, sp
    bl irq_handler
    mov sp, x0
    RESTORE_FULL_FRAME
    eret

vec_fiq:
    dsb sy
    wfe
    b vec_fiq
vec_serror:
    dsb sy
    wfe
    b vec_serror

jump_to_frame:
    mov sp, x0
    RESTORE_FULL_FRAME
    eret

.section .bss
.p2align 4
stack_bottom:
    .skip 4096 * 16
stack_top:
=== END OF FILE ===

=== START OF FILE: ./src/editor.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — editor.c
// Контент без рамки (рамку рисует WM).

#include <stdint.h>
#include "editor.h"
#include "fb.h"
#include "bkfs.h"

#define CLR_BODY     0xFF101C2E
#define CLR_FG       0xFFE0E0E0
#define CLR_CURSOR   0xFFFFD166
#define CLR_STATUS   0xFF2C4A73
#define CLR_STATUSFG 0xFFF0F0F0
#define CLR_OK       0xFF6EE7A0
#define CLR_ERR      0xFFFF6B6B

static int str_len(const char *s) { int n = 0; while (s[n]) n++; return n; }
static void str_copy_n(char *dst, const char *src, int max) {
    int i = 0;
    while (src[i] && i < max - 1) { dst[i] = src[i]; i++; }
    dst[i] = 0;
}

void editor_open(editor_t *e, const char *name) {
    str_copy_n(e->name, name, 64);
    e->len = 0;
    e->cursor = 0;
    e->cursor_visible = 1;
    e->dirty = 0;
    e->status_msg = 0;

    int n = bkfs_read(name, e->buf, EDIT_MAX - 1);
    if (n > 0) {
        e->len = (uint32_t)n;
        e->buf[e->len] = 0;
    } else {
        e->len = 0;
        e->buf[0] = 0;
    }
    e->cursor = e->len;
}

void editor_close(editor_t *e) {
    e->name[0] = 0;
    e->len = 0;
}

int editor_is_open(const editor_t *e) { return e->name[0] != 0; }

int editor_save(editor_t *e) {
    int r = bkfs_create(e->name);
    if (r == BKFS_EEXIST) r = BKFS_OK;
    if (r != BKFS_OK) { e->status_msg = 2; return 0; }

    int w = bkfs_write(e->name, e->buf, e->len);
    if (w < 0) { e->status_msg = 2; return 0; }
    e->dirty = 0;
    e->status_msg = 1;
    return 1;
}

void editor_draw_content(editor_t *e, int cx, int cy, int cw, int ch) {
    fb_fill_rect(cx, cy, cw, ch, CLR_BODY);

    int tx = cx + 8;
    int ty = cy + 4;
    int cols = (cw - 16) / 8;
    int rows = (ch - 26) / 12;
    if (rows < 1) rows = 1;
    if (cols < 1) cols = 1;

    int row = 0, col = 0;
    int cur_row = 0, cur_col = 0;
    int cursor_set = 0;

    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < e->len && row < rows; k++) {
        if (k == e->cursor) { cur_row = row; cur_col = col; cursor_set = 1; }
        char c = e->buf[k];
        if (c == '\n') { row++; col = 0; continue; }
        if (c == '\r') continue;
        fb_draw_char(tx + col * 8, ty + row * 12, c, CLR_FG, CLR_BODY);
        col++;
        if (col >= cols) { row++; col = 0; }
    }
    if (!cursor_set && e->cursor == e->len) {
        cur_row = row; cur_col = col; cursor_set = 1;
    }

    if (cursor_set && e->cursor_visible && cur_row < rows) {
        int px = tx + cur_col * 8;
        int py = ty + cur_row * 12;
        if (e->cursor < e->len && e->buf[e->cursor] != '\n') {
            char cc = e->buf[e->cursor];
            fb_draw_char(px, py, cc, CLR_BODY, CLR_CURSOR);
        } else {
            fb_fill_rect(px, py, 8, 10, CLR_CURSOR);
        }
    }

    int sy = cy + ch - 22;
    fb_fill_rect(cx, sy, cw, 22, CLR_STATUS);
    char title[80];
    int i = 0;
    for (int j = 0; e->name[j] && i < 60; j++) title[i++] = e->name[j];
    if (e->dirty) { title[i++] = ' '; title[i++] = '*'; }
    title[i] = 0;
    fb_draw_string(cx + 8, sy + 7, title, CLR_STATUSFG, CLR_STATUS);

    const char *right = 0;
    uint32_t rcol = CLR_STATUSFG;
    if (e->status_msg == 1) { right = "saved"; rcol = CLR_OK; }
    if (e->status_msg == 2) { right = "error"; rcol = CLR_ERR; }
    if (right) {
        int rlen = str_len(right);
        int rx = cx + cw - 8 - rlen * 8;
        fb_draw_string(rx, sy + 7, right, rcol, CLR_STATUS);
    }
}

void editor_key(editor_t *e, char c) {
    if (c == 0x18) { editor_save(e); return; }
    if (c == 0x19) { editor_close(e); return; }

    if (c == '\b') {
        if (e->cursor > 0) {
            for (uint32_t i = e->cursor - 1; i < e->len - 1; i++)
                e->buf[i] = e->buf[i + 1];
            e->len--;
            e->cursor--;
            e->dirty = 1;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x17) {
        if (e->cursor < e->len) {
            for (uint32_t i = e->cursor; i < e->len - 1; i++)
                e->buf[i] = e->buf[i + 1];
            e->len--;
            e->dirty = 1;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x13) { if (e->cursor > 0) e->cursor--; return; }
    if (c == 0x14) { if (e->cursor < e->len) e->cursor++; return; }
    if (c == 0x15) {
        uint32_t p = e->cursor;
        while (p > 0 && e->buf[p-1] != '\n') p--;
        e->cursor = p;
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x16) {
        uint32_t p = e->cursor;
        while (p < e->len && e->buf[p] != '\n') p++;
        e->cursor = p;
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x11) {
        uint32_t ls = e->cursor;
        while (ls > 0 && e->buf[ls-1] != '\n') ls--;
        if (ls == 0) return;
        uint32_t pe = ls - 1;
        uint32_t ps = pe;
        while (ps > 0 && e->buf[ps-1] != '\n') ps--;
        uint32_t col = e->cursor - ls;
        uint32_t plen = pe - ps;
        if (col > plen) col = plen;
        e->cursor = ps + col;
        return;
    }
    if (c == 0x12) {
        uint32_t ls = e->cursor;
        while (ls > 0 && e->buf[ls-1] != '\n') ls--;
        uint32_t le = e->cursor;
        while (le < e->len && e->buf[le] != '\n') le++;
        if (le == e->len) return;
        uint32_t ns = le + 1;
        uint32_t ne = ns;
        while (ne < e->len && e->buf[ne] != '\n') ne++;
        uint32_t col = e->cursor - ls;
        uint32_t nlen = ne - ns;
        if (col > nlen) col = nlen;
        e->cursor = ns + col;
        return;
    }

    if ((unsigned char)c < 0x20 && c != '\n') return;
    if (e->len >= EDIT_MAX - 1) return;

    for (uint32_t i = e->len; i > e->cursor; i--)
        e->buf[i] = e->buf[i - 1];
    e->buf[e->cursor] = c;
    e->len++;
    e->cursor++;
    e->buf[e->len] = 0;
    e->dirty = 1;
}
