=== START OF FILE: ./src/blk.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — blk.c
// Драйвер virtio-blk. Один request queue, синхронные запросы.
// Каждый запрос — 3 дескриптора: header + data + status.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "blk.h"
#include "virtio.h"
#include "pci.h"
#include "physmem.h"

extern void uart_puts(const char *s);
extern void uart_puthex(uint64_t v);
extern void uart_putu(uint64_t v);

static inline void dsb_sy(void) { __asm__ volatile("dsb sy" ::: "memory"); }

// virtio-blk request header (16 байт).
typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint32_t type;
    uint32_t reserved;
    uint64_t sector;
} virtio_blk_req_t;

#define VIRTIO_BLK_T_IN     0
#define VIRTIO_BLK_T_OUT    1
#define VIRTIO_BLK_T_FLUSH  4

static void cache_invalidate(void *addr, uint64_t len) {
    uint64_t a = (uint64_t)addr & ~63ull;
    uint64_t end = ((uint64_t)addr + len + 63) & ~63ull;
    while (a < end) { __asm__ volatile("dc ivac, %0" :: "r"(a)); a += 64; }
    dsb_sy();
}

static void cache_clean(void *addr, uint64_t len) {
    uint64_t a = (uint64_t)addr & ~63ull;
    uint64_t end = ((uint64_t)addr + len + 63) & ~63ull;
    while (a < end) { __asm__ volatile("dc cvac, %0" :: "r"(a)); a += 64; }
    dsb_sy();
}

static virtio_mmio_t g_io;
static virtqueue_t   g_vq;
static int           g_ready = 0;
static uint64_t      g_capacity = 0;

static uint8_t *g_hdr_buf = 0;   // 16 байт
static uint8_t *g_sts_buf = 0;   // 1 байт
static uint8_t *g_dat_buf = 0;   // 512 байт

int blk_init(uint64_t ecam_base) {
    g_ready = 0;

    int b, d, f;
    // modern virtio-blk PCI device id = 0x1042
    if (!pci_find_device(ecam_base, 0x1AF4, 0x1042, &b, &d, &f)) return 0;

    uint32_t bar4 = pci_cfg_read32(ecam_base, b, d, f, 0x10 + 4 * 4);
    if ((bar4 & ~0xFull) == 0) {
        pci_assign_bar64(ecam_base, b, d, f, 4, 0x10300000ull);
        dsb_sy();
    }

    if (!pci_parse_virtio_caps(ecam_base, b, d, f, &g_io)) return 0;

    virtio_state_t st;
    virtio_transport_init(&g_io, &st);
    if (!virtio_set_features(&g_io, VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1, &st)) return 0;
    if (!virtio_setup_queue(&g_io, 0, &g_vq)) return 0;
    if (!virtio_activate(&g_io, &st)) return 0;

    g_hdr_buf = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    g_sts_buf = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    g_dat_buf = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    if (!g_hdr_buf || !g_sts_buf || !g_dat_buf) return 0;

    // Читаем capacity из device config: первые 8 байт.
    g_capacity = *(volatile uint64_t *)(g_io.device + 0);
    g_ready = 1;
    return 1;
}

uint64_t blk_capacity(void) { return g_capacity; }

static int blk_do(uint32_t type, uint64_t sector, void *buf, int is_write) {
    if (!g_ready) return 0;

    virtio_blk_req_t *hdr = (virtio_blk_req_t *)g_hdr_buf;
    hdr->type     = type;
    hdr->reserved = 0;
    hdr->sector   = sector;

    *g_sts_buf = 0xFF;   // sentinel

    if (is_write) {
        const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)buf;
        for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) g_dat_buf[i] = src[i];
    }

    cache_clean(g_hdr_buf, 16);
    if (is_write) cache_clean(g_dat_buf, 512);
    cache_clean(g_sts_buf, 1);

    // Descriptor chain: hdr -> data -> status
    g_vq.desc[0].addr  = (uint64_t)g_hdr_buf; g_vq.desc[0].len = 16;
    g_vq.desc[0].flags = VIRTQ_DESC_F_NEXT;   g_vq.desc[0].next = 1;

    g_vq.desc[1].addr  = (uint64_t)g_dat_buf; g_vq.desc[1].len = 512;
    g_vq.desc[1].flags = VIRTQ_DESC_F_NEXT | (is_write ? 0 : VIRTQ_DESC_F_WRITE);
    g_vq.desc[1].next  = 2;

    g_vq.desc[2].addr  = (uint64_t)g_sts_buf; g_vq.desc[2].len = 1;
    g_vq.desc[2].flags = VIRTQ_DESC_F_WRITE;  g_vq.desc[2].next = 0;

    cache_clean(g_vq.desc, sizeof(virtq_desc_t) * 3);

    uint16_t aidx = g_vq.avail->idx;
    g_vq.avail->ring[aidx % g_vq.queue_size] = 0;
    dsb_sy();
    g_vq.avail->idx = aidx + 1;
    cache_clean(g_vq.avail, sizeof(virtq_avail_t));

    virtio_queue_notify(&g_io, &g_vq);

    uint64_t t = 20000000;
    while (t > 0) {
        cache_invalidate(g_vq.used, sizeof(virtq_used_t));
        if (g_vq.used->idx == aidx + 1) break;
        t--;
    }
    if (t == 0) return 0;

    cache_invalidate(g_sts_buf, 1);
    if (*g_sts_buf != 0) return 0;

    if (!is_write) {
        cache_invalidate(g_dat_buf, 512);
        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)buf;
        for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) dst[i] = g_dat_buf[i];
    }

    return 1;
}

int blk_read_sector(uint64_t sector, void *buf) {
    return blk_do(VIRTIO_BLK_T_IN, sector, buf, 0);
}

int blk_write_sector(uint64_t sector, const void *buf) {
    return blk_do(VIRTIO_BLK_T_OUT, sector, (void *)buf, 1);
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/wallpaper.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — wallpaper.c
// Пресеты обоев рабочего стола (вертикальные градиенты).

#include <stdint.h>
#include "wallpaper.h"
#include "fb.h"

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    uint32_t    top;
    uint32_t    bot;
} wp_preset_t;

static const wp_preset_t g_presets[] = {
    { "default", 0xFF2A4A75, 0xFF12243E },   // классический синий
    { "night",   0xFF1A1A3A, 0xFF05050F },   // ночь
    { "forest",  0xFF1F3A22, 0xFF08160A },   // лес
    { "sunset",  0xFF6F3A1F, 0xFF2A0A05 },   // закат
    { "ocean",   0xFF1A4568, 0xFF061828 },   // океан
    { "purple",  0xFF3A1A55, 0xFF12041E },   // фиолетовый
    { "steel",   0xFF3A3A42, 0xFF14141A },   // сталь
    { "void",    0xFF0A0A0A, 0xFF000000 },   // почти чёрный
};

#define WP_COUNT ((int)(sizeof(g_presets) / sizeof(g_presets[0])))

static int g_current = 0;

static int str_eq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) { if (*a++ != *b++) return 0; }
    return *a == 0 && *b == 0;
}

int wallpaper_count(void) { return WP_COUNT; }

const char *wallpaper_name(int idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= WP_COUNT) return 0;
    return g_presets[idx].name;
}

const char *wallpaper_current_name(void) {
    return g_presets[g_current].name;
}

int wallpaper_set_by_name(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < WP_COUNT; i++) {
        if (str_eq(g_presets[i].name, name)) {
            g_current = i;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void wallpaper_set_by_index(int idx) {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= WP_COUNT) return;
    g_current = idx;
}

void wallpaper_draw(void) {
    const wp_preset_t *p = &g_presets[g_current];
    fb_fill_gradient_v(0, 0, 1280, 800, p->top, p->bot);
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/startmenu.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — startmenu.c
// Меню «Пуск» с живыми кнопками: 3D-иконки, hover, подписи, стрелки.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "startmenu.h"
#include "fb.h"

extern void uart_puts(const char *s);

#define MENU_W 240
#define ITEM_H 48
#define HEADER_H 28
#define MENU_H (HEADER_H + STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT * ITEM_H + 6)

#define MENU_X 8
#define MENU_Y 552       // над иконкой B в доке

static int g_open  = 0;
static int g_hover = -1;

static const char *g_labels[STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT] = {
    "Shutdown",
    "Reboot",
    "Sleep",
    "Hibernate",
};

static const char *g_sub[STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT] = {
    "power off",
    "restart",
    "low power",
    "to disk",
};

static const uint32_t g_icon_top[STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT] = {
    0xFFFF7A72,   // яркая верхушка
    0xFFFFD050,
    0xFF6AB0FF,
    0xFFB878D8,
};

static const uint32_t g_icon_bot[STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT] = {
    0xFFB03030,   // тёмный низ
    0xFFB08020,
    0xFF2A6088,
    0xFF5A2A70,
};

void startmenu_toggle(void) { g_open = !g_open; g_hover = -1; }
void startmenu_close(void)  { g_open = 0; g_hover = -1; }
int  startmenu_is_open(void) { return g_open; }

int startmenu_hit(int x, int y) {
    if (!g_open) return -1;
    if (x < MENU_X || x >= MENU_X + MENU_W) return -1;
    int top = MENU_Y + HEADER_H;
    int bot = top + STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT * ITEM_H;
    if (y < top || y >= bot) return -1;
    int idx = (y - top) / ITEM_H;
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT) return -1;
    return idx;
}

// Кружок с 3D-эффектом: верхняя половина светлее, нижняя темнее.
static void draw_circle_3d(int cx, int cy, int r, uint32_t top, uint32_t bot) {
    for (int j = -r; j <= r; j++) {
        for (int i = -r; i <= r; i++) {
            int d2 = i*i + j*j;
            if (d2 > r*r) continue;
            uint32_t col = (j < 0) ? top : bot;
            fb_putpixel(cx + i, cy + j, col);
        }
    }
    // Чёрный контур по краю.
    for (int j = -r - 1; j <= r + 1; j++) {
        for (int i = -r - 1; i <= r + 1; i++) {
            int inside  = (i*i + j*j) <= r*r;
            int inside2 = ((i+1)*(i+1) + j*j) <= r*r &&
                          ((i-1)*(i-1) + j*j) <= r*r &&
                          (i*i + (j+1)*(j+1)) <= r*r &&
                          (i*i + (j-1)*(j-1)) <= r*r;
            if (inside2 && !inside) {
                fb_putpixel(cx + i, cy + j, 0xFF101010);
            }
        }
    }
    // Блик.
    fb_putpixel(cx - r/2, cy - r/2, 0xFFFFFFFF);
    fb_putpixel(cx - r/2 + 1, cy - r/2, 0xFFFFFFFF);
    fb_putpixel(cx - r/2, cy - r/2 + 1, 0xFFEEEEEE);
}

// Стрелка ">" справа.
static void draw_arrow(int x, int y, uint32_t col) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        fb_putpixel(x + i, y - i, col);
        fb_putpixel(x + i, y + i, col);
    }
    fb_fill_rect(x, y, 5, 1, col);
}

void startmenu_draw(int mx, int my) {
    if (!g_open) return;

    // Тень.
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 4, MENU_Y + 4, MENU_W, MENU_H, 0x40000000);
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 2, MENU_Y + 2, MENU_W, MENU_H, 0x80000000);

    // Тело.
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X, MENU_Y, MENU_W, MENU_H, 0xFF142844);

    // Обводка.
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X, MENU_Y, MENU_W, 1, 0xFF4A90E2);
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X, MENU_Y + MENU_H - 1, MENU_W, 1, 0xFF4A90E2);
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X, MENU_Y, 1, MENU_H, 0xFF4A90E2);
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + MENU_W - 1, MENU_Y, 1, MENU_H, 0xFF4A90E2);

    // Заголовок.
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 1, MENU_Y + 1, MENU_W - 2, HEADER_H, 0xFF2C4A73);
    fb_draw_string(MENU_X + 12, MENU_Y + 8, "Brainix", 0xFFF0F0F0, 0xFF2C4A73);
    fb_draw_string(MENU_X + 76, MENU_Y + 8, "Menu", 0xFF7AB8FF, 0xFF2C4A73);
    fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 1, MENU_Y + HEADER_H - 1, MENU_W - 2, 1, 0xFF4A90E2);

    // Hover.
    g_hover = startmenu_hit(mx, my);

    for (int i = 0; i < STARTMENU_ITEM_COUNT; i++) {
        int iy = MENU_Y + HEADER_H + i * ITEM_H;

        if (i == STARTMENU_ITEM_SLEEP) {
            fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 12, iy, MENU_W - 24, 1, 0xFF0D1F33);
        }

        int is_hov = (i == g_hover);
        uint32_t bg;
        if (is_hov) {
            bg = 0xFF3A5A80;
            fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 1, iy, MENU_W - 2, ITEM_H, bg);
            fb_fill_rect(MENU_X + 1, iy, 3, ITEM_H, 0xFF4A90E2);
        } else {
            bg = 0xFF142844;
        }

        // 3D-иконка.
        int ic_x = MENU_X + 28;
        int ic_y = iy + ITEM_H / 2;
        draw_circle_3d(ic_x, ic_y, 9, g_icon_top[i], g_icon_bot[i]);

        // Основной текст.
        uint32_t fg = is_hov ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFFD8D8D8;
        fb_draw_string(MENU_X + 52, iy + 10, g_labels[i], fg, bg);

        // Мелкая подпись ниже.
        uint32_t fg2 = is_hov ? 0xFFD0E5FF : 0xFF7A8A9A;
        fb_draw_string(MENU_X + 52, iy + 26, g_sub[i], fg2, bg);

        // Стрелка при hover.
        if (is_hov) {
            draw_arrow(MENU_X + MENU_W - 24, iy + ITEM_H / 2, 0xFF7AB8FF);
        }
    }
}

// ---- Действия ----

void system_shutdown(void) {
    uart_puts("[power] shutdown requested\n");
    register uint64_t x0 __asm__("x0") = 0x84000008;
    __asm__ volatile("hvc #0" : "+r"(x0));
    for (;;) __asm__ volatile("wfe");
}

void system_reboot(void) {
    uart_puts("[power] reboot requested\n");
    register uint64_t x0 __asm__("x0") = 0x84000009;
    __asm__ volatile("hvc #0" : "+r"(x0));
    for (;;) __asm__ volatile("wfe");
}

// -------- brainix --------
void icon_draw_brainix(int x, int y, int selected) {
    (void)selected;
    int cx = 15, cy = 15, r = 13;
    for (int j = -r; j <= r; j++)
        for (int i = -r; i <= r; i++)
            if (i*i + j*j <= r*r)
                fb_putpixel(x + cx + i, y + cy + j, CLR_ACCENT);

    for (int j = -r - 1; j <= r + 1; j++) {
        for (int i = -r - 1; i <= r + 1; i++) {
            int inside  = (i*i + j*j) <= r*r;
            int inside2 = ((i+1)*(i+1) + j*j) <= r*r &&
                          ((i-1)*(i-1) + j*j) <= r*r &&
                          (i*i + (j+1)*(j+1)) <= r*r &&
                          (i*i + (j-1)*(j-1)) <= r*r;
            if (inside2 && !inside) fb_putpixel(x + cx + i, y + cy + j, CLR_INK);
        }
    }
    fb_draw_char(x + 11, y + 11, 'B', CLR_PAPER, CLR_ACCENT);
}

// -------- computer (My Computer) --------
void icon_draw_computer(int x, int y, int selected) {
    (void)selected;
    // Монитор — рамка.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 1, y + 3, 30, 22, CLR_INK);
    // Экран.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 3, y + 5, 26, 18, CLR_MONITOR);
    // Блик.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 5, y + 7, 10, 4, CLR_MONITOR2);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 5, y + 7, 3, 8, CLR_MONITOR2);
    // Подставка.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 13, y + 25, 6, 4, CLR_INK);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 8, y + 29, 16, 3, CLR_INK);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 9, y + 29, 14, 1, 0xFF808080);
}

// -------- recycle (Recycle Bin) --------
void icon_draw_recycle(int x, int y, int selected) {
    (void)selected;
    // Ручка сверху.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 13, y + 1, 6, 3, CLR_INK);
    // Крышка.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 4, y + 4, 24, 5, CLR_INK);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 5, y + 5, 22, 3, CLR_BIN2);
    // Тело корзины — конус.
    for (int j = 0; j < 22; j++) {
        int w = 20 - j / 4;
        int lx = x + 6 + (20 - w) / 2;
        fb_fill_rect(lx, y + 9 + j, w, 1, CLR_BIN);
    }
    // Контур.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 6, y + 9, 2, 22, CLR_INK);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 24, y + 9, 2, 22, CLR_INK);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 8, y + 29, 16, 2, CLR_INK);
    // Полоски.
    fb_fill_rect(x + 12, y + 12, 2, 15, CLR_BIN_DK);
    fb_fill_rect(x + 18, y + 12, 2, 15, CLR_BIN_DK);
}

=== START OF FILE: ./src/kbd.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — kbd.c
// virtio-keyboard + отслеживание Ctrl для спец-кодов.
// 0x11 UP, 0x12 DOWN, 0x13 LEFT, 0x14 RIGHT, 0x15 HOME, 0x16 END, 0x17 DEL,
// 0x18 CTRL+S, 0x19 CTRL+Q.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "kbd.h"
#include "virtio.h"
#include "pci.h"
#include "physmem.h"

extern void uart_puts(const char *s);
extern void uart_puthex(uint64_t v);

static inline void dsb_sy(void) { __asm__ volatile("dsb sy" ::: "memory"); }

typedef struct __attribute__((packed)) {
    uint16_t type;
    uint16_t code;
    uint32_t value;
} virtio_input_event_t;

#define EV_SYN  0x00
#define EV_KEY  0x01

#define KEY_ESC        1
#define KEY_1          2
#define KEY_2          3
#define KEY_3          4
#define KEY_4          5
#define KEY_5          6
#define KEY_6          7
#define KEY_7          8
#define KEY_8          9
#define KEY_9         10
#define KEY_0         11
#define KEY_MINUS     12
#define KEY_EQUAL     13
#define KEY_BACKSPACE 14
#define KEY_TAB       15
#define KEY_Q         16
#define KEY_W         17
#define KEY_E         18
#define KEY_R         19
#define KEY_T         20
#define KEY_Y         21
#define KEY_U         22
#define KEY_I         23
#define KEY_O         24
#define KEY_P         25
#define KEY_LEFTBRACE 26
#define KEY_RIGHTBRACE 27
#define KEY_ENTER     28
#define KEY_LEFTCTRL  29
#define KEY_A         30
#define KEY_S         31
#define KEY_D         32
#define KEY_F         33
#define KEY_G         34
#define KEY_H         35
#define KEY_J         36
#define KEY_K         37
#define KEY_L         38
#define KEY_SEMICOLON 39
#define KEY_APOSTROPHE 40
#define KEY_GRAVE     41
#define KEY_BACKSLASH 43
#define KEY_Z         44
#define KEY_X         45
#define KEY_C         46
#define KEY_V         47
#define KEY_B         48
#define KEY_N         49
#define KEY_M         50
#define KEY_COMMA     51
#define KEY_DOT       52
#define KEY_SLASH     53
#define KEY_SPACE     57
#define KEY_HOME      102
#define KEY_UP        103
#define KEY_LEFT      105
#define KEY_RIGHT     106
#define KEY_END       107
#define KEY_DOWN      108
#define KEY_DELETE    111
#define KEY_RIGHTCTRL 97

#define K_UP     0x11
#define K_DOWN   0x12
#define K_LEFT   0x13
#define K_RIGHT  0x14
#define K_HOME   0x15
#define K_END    0x16
#define K_DEL    0x17
#define K_CTRL_S 0x18
#define K_CTRL_Q 0x19

static int g_ctrl_down = 0;

static char translate(uint16_t code) {
    // Спец-комбинации с Ctrl.
    if (g_ctrl_down) {
        if (code == KEY_S) return K_CTRL_S;
        if (code == KEY_Q) return K_CTRL_Q;
    }

    switch (code) {
        case KEY_A: return 'a'; case KEY_B: return 'b'; case KEY_C: return 'c';
        case KEY_D: return 'd'; case KEY_E: return 'e'; case KEY_F: return 'f';
        case KEY_G: return 'g'; case KEY_H: return 'h'; case KEY_I: return 'i';
        case KEY_J: return 'j'; case KEY_K: return 'k'; case KEY_L: return 'l';
        case KEY_M: return 'm'; case KEY_N: return 'n'; case KEY_O: return 'o';
        case KEY_P: return 'p'; case KEY_Q: return 'q'; case KEY_R: return 'r';
        case KEY_S: return 's'; case KEY_T: return 't'; case KEY_U: return 'u';
        case KEY_V: return 'v'; case KEY_W: return 'w'; case KEY_X: return 'x';
        case KEY_Y: return 'y'; case KEY_Z: return 'z';

        case KEY_1: return '1'; case KEY_2: return '2'; case KEY_3: return '3';
        case KEY_4: return '4'; case KEY_5: return '5'; case KEY_6: return '6';
        case KEY_7: return '7'; case KEY_8: return '8'; case KEY_9: return '9';
        case KEY_0: return '0';

        case KEY_SPACE: return ' ';
        case KEY_ENTER: return '\n';
        case KEY_BACKSPACE: return '\b';
        case KEY_TAB: return '\t';
        case KEY_MINUS: return '-';
        case KEY_EQUAL: return '=';
        case KEY_LEFTBRACE: return '[';
        case KEY_RIGHTBRACE: return ']';
        case KEY_SEMICOLON: return ';';
        case KEY_APOSTROPHE: return '\'';
        case KEY_GRAVE: return '`';
        case KEY_BACKSLASH: return '\\';
        case KEY_COMMA: return ',';
        case KEY_DOT: return '.';
        case KEY_SLASH: return '/';

        case KEY_UP:     return K_UP;
        case KEY_DOWN:   return K_DOWN;
        case KEY_LEFT:   return K_LEFT;
        case KEY_RIGHT:  return K_RIGHT;
        case KEY_HOME:   return K_HOME;
        case KEY_END:    return K_END;
        case KEY_DELETE: return K_DEL;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

static virtio_mmio_t g_io;
static virtqueue_t   g_evq;
static int           g_ready = 0;

static uint8_t *g_event_bufs = 0;
static uint16_t g_last_used = 0;

static void (*g_handler)(char) = 0;

void kbd_set_handler(void (*handler)(char c)) {
    g_handler = handler;
}

int kbd_init(uint64_t ecam_base) {
    g_ready = 0;

    int b, d, f;
    if (!pci_find_device(ecam_base, 0x1AF4, 0x1052, &b, &d, &f)) return 0;

    uint32_t bar4 = pci_cfg_read32(ecam_base, b, d, f, 0x10 + 4 * 4);
    if ((bar4 & ~0xFull) == 0) {
        pci_assign_bar64(ecam_base, b, d, f, 4, 0x10100000ull);
        dsb_sy();
    }

    if (!pci_parse_virtio_caps(ecam_base, b, d, f, &g_io)) return 0;

    virtio_state_t st;
    virtio_transport_init(&g_io, &st);
    if (!virtio_set_features(&g_io, VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1, &st)) return 0;
    if (!virtio_setup_queue(&g_io, 0, &g_evq)) return 0;
    if (!virtio_activate(&g_io, &st)) return 0;

    g_event_bufs = (uint8_t *)phys_alloc_page();
    if (!g_event_bufs) return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < g_evq.queue_size; i++) {
        g_evq.desc[i].addr  = (uint64_t)(g_event_bufs + i * 8);
        g_evq.desc[i].len   = 8;
        g_evq.desc[i].flags = VIRTQ_DESC_F_WRITE;
        g_evq.desc[i].next  = 0;
    }
    {
        uint64_t a = (uint64_t)g_evq.desc & ~63ull;
        uint64_t e = ((uint64_t)g_evq.desc + sizeof(virtq_desc_t) * g_evq.queue_size + 63) & ~63ull;
        while (a < e) { __asm__ volatile("dc cvac, %0" :: "r"(a)); a += 64; }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < g_evq.queue_size; i++) g_evq.avail->ring[i] = (uint16_t)i;
    g_evq.avail->idx = g_evq.queue_size;
    {
        uint64_t a = (uint64_t)g_evq.avail & ~63ull;
        uint64_t e = ((uint64_t)g_evq.avail + sizeof(virtq_avail_t) + 63) & ~63ull;
        while (a < e) { __asm__ volatile("dc cvac, %0" :: "r"(a)); a += 64; }
    }
    dsb_sy();

    virtio_queue_notify(&g_io, &g_evq);

    g_last_used = 0;
    g_ready = 1;
    return 1;
}

void kbd_poll(void) {
    if (!g_ready) return;

    {
        uint64_t a = (uint64_t)g_evq.used & ~63ull;
        uint64_t e = ((uint64_t)g_evq.used + sizeof(virtq_used_t) + 63) & ~63ull;
        while (a < e) { __asm__ volatile("dc ivac, %0" :: "r"(a)); a += 64; }
    }
    dsb_sy();

    uint16_t cur = g_evq.used->idx;

    while (g_last_used != cur) {
        uint32_t id  = g_evq.used->ring[g_last_used % g_evq.queue_size].id;
        uint32_t len = g_evq.used->ring[g_last_used % g_evq.queue_size].len;

        if (id < g_evq.queue_size && len == 8) {
            uint8_t *evp = g_event_bufs + id * 8;
            uint64_t a = (uint64_t)evp & ~63ull;
            __asm__ volatile("dc ivac, %0" :: "r"(a));
            dsb_sy();

            virtio_input_event_t *ev = (virtio_input_event_t *)evp;

            if (ev->type == EV_KEY) {
                // Отслеживаем состояние Ctrl.
                if (ev->code == KEY_LEFTCTRL || ev->code == KEY_RIGHTCTRL) {
                    g_ctrl_down = (ev->value != 0);
                } else if (ev->value == 1) {
                    char ch = translate(ev->code);
                    if (ch && g_handler) g_handler(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        g_evq.avail->ring[g_evq.avail->idx % g_evq.queue_size] = (uint16_t)id;
        dsb_sy();
        g_evq.avail->idx++;
        {
            uint64_t a = (uint64_t)g_evq.avail & ~63ull;
            uint64_t e = ((uint64_t)g_evq.avail + sizeof(virtq_avail_t) + 63) & ~63ull;
            while (a < e) { __asm__ volatile("dc cvac, %0" :: "r"(a)); a += 64; }
        }
        dsb_sy();

        g_last_used++;
    }

    if (cur != 0) virtio_queue_notify(&g_io, &g_evq);
}

// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — pci.h
#ifndef BKOS_PCI_H
#define BKOS_PCI_H

#include <stdint.h>

// Найти N-е устройство по vendor/device (skip=0 — первое).

                        int skip, int *out_bus, int *out_dev, int *out_fn);

// Обёртка: ищет первое совпадение.

                    int *out_bus, int *out_dev, int *out_fn);

uint32_t pci_cfg_read32(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off);
uint16_t pci_cfg_read16(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off);

void     pci_cfg_write16(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, uint32_t off, uint16_t v);

void     pci_assign_bar64(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, int bar_idx, uint64_t addr);
uint64_t pci_bar_base(uint64_t ecam, int b, int d, int f, int bar_idx);

#endif

// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — files.h

    int      cursor_visible;

=== START OF FILE: ./src/win.h ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — win.h
#ifndef BKOS_WIN_H
#define BKOS_WIN_H

#include <stdint.h>

#define WIN_HISTORY_MAX   26
#define WIN_LINE_MAX      96
#define WIN_INPUT_MAX     80

    char history[WIN_HISTORY_MAX][WIN_LINE_MAX];

} win_t;

=== START OF FILE: ./src/ksh.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — ksh.c
// Кольцевой буфер вывода для user-программ, работающих в окне.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "ksh.h"

#define KSH_BUF_SIZE 4096
static char     g_buf[KSH_BUF_SIZE];
static uint32_t g_head = 0;
static uint32_t g_tail = 0;

void ksh_init(void) {
    g_head = 0;
    g_tail = 0;
}

void ksh_out_write(const char *data, uint32_t len) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        uint32_t next = (g_head + 1) % KSH_BUF_SIZE;
        if (next == g_tail) return;    // полный — дропаем
        g_buf[g_head] = data[i];
        g_head = next;
    }
}

int ksh_out_pop_line(char *out, int max) {
    if (g_head == g_tail) return 0;

    uint32_t p = g_tail;
    int n = 0;
    while (p != g_head) {
        char c = g_buf[p];
        if (c == '\n') {
            out[n] = 0;
            g_tail = (p + 1) % KSH_BUF_SIZE;
            return 1;
        }
        if (n < max - 1) out[n++] = c;
        p = (p + 1) % KSH_BUF_SIZE;
    }
    return 0;
}

void ksh_out_flush_partial(void) {
    if (g_head == g_tail) return;
    // Просто добавим перевод строки в конец, чтобы pop_line его выдал.
    char nl = '\n';
    ksh_out_write(&nl, 1);
}
=== END OF FILE ===

=== START OF FILE: ./src/mmu.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — mmu.c
// Шаг 13h: L3 расширен с 2 MB до 64 MB. Теперь user code/stack
// и любые user-маппинги в первых 64 MB RAM работают.

#include <stdint.h>
#include "mmu.h"

static inline void dsb_sy(void) { __asm__ volatile("dsb sy" ::: "memory"); }
static inline void isb(void)    { __asm__ volatile("isb"    ::: "memory"); }

// ---------- TCR_EL1 ----------
#define TCR_T0SZ_16     (16ull)
#define TCR_IRGN0_WBWA  (1ull << 8)
#define TCR_ORGN0_WBWA  (1ull << 10)
#define TCR_SH0_IS      (3ull << 12)
#define TCR_TG0_4K      (0ull << 14)
#define TCR_IPS_40BIT   (2ull << 32)
#define TCR_EPD1_DIS    (1ull << 23)

#define TCR_VALUE ( \
    TCR_T0SZ_16 | TCR_IRGN0_WBWA | TCR_ORGN0_WBWA | \
    TCR_SH0_IS  | TCR_TG0_4K     | TCR_IPS_40BIT  | TCR_EPD1_DIS )

#define MAIR_ATTR_NORMAL 0xFFull
#define MAIR_ATTR_DEVICE 0x00ull
#define MAIR_VALUE ((MAIR_ATTR_NORMAL << 0) | (MAIR_ATTR_DEVICE << 8))

// ---------- Descriptor bits ----------
#define PTE_VALID       (1ull << 0)
#define PTE_BIT1        (1ull << 1)   // table на L0..L2, page на L3
#define PTE_AF          (1ull << 10)
#define PTE_SH_IS       (3ull << 8)
#define PTE_AP_RW_EL1   (0ull << 6)   // AP[2:1]=00 → EL1 RW, EL0 no access
#define PTE_AP_RW_EL0   (1ull << 6)   // AP[2:1]=01 → EL1 RW, EL0 RW
#define PTE_ATTR_IDX(n) ((uint64_t)(n) << 2)
#define PTE_PXN         (1ull << 53)
#define PTE_UXN         (1ull << 54)

#define DESC_TABLE       (PTE_VALID | PTE_BIT1)

#define DESC_BLOCK_NORMAL \
    (PTE_VALID | PTE_AF | PTE_SH_IS | PTE_AP_RW_EL1 | \
     PTE_ATTR_IDX(0) | PTE_UXN)

#define DESC_BLOCK_DEVICE \
    (PTE_VALID | PTE_AF | PTE_AP_RW_EL1 | \
     PTE_ATTR_IDX(1) | PTE_PXN | PTE_UXN)

#define DESC_PAGE_KERNEL \
    (PTE_VALID | PTE_BIT1 | PTE_AF | PTE_SH_IS | PTE_AP_RW_EL1 | \
     PTE_ATTR_IDX(0) | PTE_UXN)

// ---------- Диапазон L3: [0x40000000, 0x44000000) = 64 MB ----------
// 32 L2-записи по 2 MB, каждая указывает на свою L3-таблицу (512 страниц).
#define L3_VA_BASE  0x40000000ull
#define L3_VA_END   0x44000000ull
#define L3_COUNT    32

// ---------- Таблицы в .bss ----------
static uint64_t l0_table[512]  __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t l1_table[512]  __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t l2_low[512]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t l2_ram[512]    __attribute__((aligned(4096)));
static uint64_t l2_pcie[512]   __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

// 32 L3-таблицы, каждая 4 KB → 128 KB .bss.
static uint64_t l3_tables[L3_COUNT][512] __attribute__((aligned(4096)));

static void build_tables(void) {
    // L0[0] → L1
    l0_table[0] = (uint64_t)l1_table | DESC_TABLE;

    // L1[0] → низкие 1 GB (Device). L1[1] → RAM. L1[256] → PCIe ECAM.
    l1_table[0]   = (uint64_t)l2_low  | DESC_TABLE;
    l1_table[1]   = (uint64_t)l2_ram  | DESC_TABLE;
    l1_table[256] = (uint64_t)l2_pcie | DESC_TABLE;

    // L2_low: Device-nGnRnE
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
        uint64_t pa = 0x00000000ull + i * 0x200000ull;
        l2_low[i] = pa | DESC_BLOCK_DEVICE;
    }

    // L2_ram[0..31] → L3-таблицы (постранично 4 KB).
    // L2_ram[32..511] → 2 MB Normal WB блоки.
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < L3_COUNT; i++) {
        l2_ram[i] = (uint64_t)&l3_tables[i][0] | DESC_TABLE;
    }
    for (uint64_t i = L3_COUNT; i < 512; i++) {
        uint64_t pa = 0x40000000ull + i * 0x200000ull;
        l2_ram[i] = pa | DESC_BLOCK_NORMAL;
    }

    // L3: все страницы сначала ядерные (EL1 only).
    for (uint64_t t = 0; t < L3_COUNT; t++) {
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
            uint64_t pa = L3_VA_BASE + t * 0x200000ull + i * 0x1000ull;
            l3_tables[t][i] = pa | DESC_PAGE_KERNEL;
        }
    }

    // PCIe ECAM 0x4000000000..0x4040000000 — Device-nGnRnE.
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
        uint64_t pa = 0x4000000000ull + i * 0x200000ull;
        l2_pcie[i] = pa | DESC_BLOCK_DEVICE;
    }
}

void mmu_init(void) {
    build_tables();
    dsb_sy();
    isb();

    __asm__ volatile("msr mair_el1, %0" :: "r"(MAIR_VALUE));
    isb();
    __asm__ volatile("msr tcr_el1, %0" :: "r"(TCR_VALUE));
    isb();

    __asm__ volatile("msr ttbr0_el1, %0" :: "r"((uint64_t)l0_table));
    __asm__ volatile("msr ttbr1_el1, %0" :: "r"(0ull));
    dsb_sy();
    isb();

    __asm__ volatile("tlbi vmalle1" ::: "memory");
    dsb_sy();
    isb();
    __asm__ volatile("ic iallu" ::: "memory");
    dsb_sy();
    isb();

    uint64_t sctlr;
    __asm__ volatile("mrs %0, sctlr_el1" : "=r"(sctlr));
    sctlr |= (1ull << 0);    // M
    sctlr |= (1ull << 2);    // C
    sctlr |= (1ull << 12);   // I
    __asm__ volatile("msr sctlr_el1, %0" :: "r"(sctlr));
    isb();
}

void mmu_user_map_page(uint64_t pa, int is_code) {
    if (pa < L3_VA_BASE || pa >= L3_VA_END) return;
    if (pa & 0xFFFull) return;

    uint64_t off = pa - L3_VA_BASE;
    uint64_t t   = off / 0x200000ull;               // индекс L3-таблицы
    uint64_t i   = (off % 0x200000ull) / 0x1000ull; // индекс страницы в L3

    uint64_t flags = PTE_VALID | PTE_BIT1 | PTE_AF | PTE_SH_IS |
                     PTE_ATTR_IDX(0) | PTE_AP_RW_EL0 | PTE_PXN;
    if (!is_code) flags |= PTE_UXN;

    l3_tables[t][i] = (pa & ~0xFFFull) | flags;

    dsb_sy();
    __asm__ volatile("tlbi vmalle1" ::: "memory");
    dsb_sy();
    isb();
}
=== END OF FILE ===


=== START OF FILE: ./src/dtb.c ===
// BrainixKernel (BKOS) — dtb.c
// FDT-парсер: RAM banks + framebuffer + PCIe ECAM.
// Поиск PCIe ECAM ведём по compatible = "pci-host-ecam-generic",
// а не по имени узла: QEMU называет его "pcie@...", не "pci@...".

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include "dtb.h"

#define FDT_MAGIC      0xD00DFEEDu
#define FDT_BEGIN_NODE 1u
#define FDT_END_NODE   2u
#define FDT_PROP       3u
#define FDT_NOP        4u
#define FDT_END        9u

static const void *g_dtb = 0;

void dtb_set(void *ptr) { g_dtb = ptr; }
const void *dtb_get_ptr(void) { return g_dtb; }

static inline uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p) {
    return ((uint32_t)p[0] << 24) | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 16) |
           ((uint32_t)p[2] << 8)  |  (uint32_t)p[3];
}

static inline uint64_t be64(const uint8_t *p) {
    return ((uint64_t)be32(p) << 32) | be32(p + 4);
}

static int name_is(const char *s, const char *prefix) {
    while (*prefix) { if (*s++ != *prefix++) return 0; }
    return (*s == '\0' || *s == '@');
}

static int name_starts(const char *s, const char *prefix) {
    while (*prefix) { if (*s++ != *prefix++) return 0; }
    return 1;
}

static int str_eq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    while (*a && *b) { if (*a++ != *b++) return 0; }
    return *a == '\0' && *b == '\0';
}

// Проверка: содержит ли property compatible строку s (может быть
// несколько строк, разделённых \0).
static int compat_contains(const uint8_t *val, uint32_t len, const char *s) {
    uint32_t off = 0;
    while (off < len) {
        const char *cur = (const char *)(val + off);
        uint32_t l = 0;
        while (off + l < len && cur[l]) l++;
        if (str_eq(cur, s)) return 1;
        off += l + 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---------- RAM banks ----------
int dtb_get_ram_banks(ram_bank_t *out, int max) {
    if (!g_dtb || max <= 0) return 0;

    const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)g_dtb;
    if (be32(base) != FDT_MAGIC) return 0;

    uint32_t off_struct  = be32(base + 8);
    uint32_t off_strings = be32(base + 12);

    const uint8_t *p    = base + off_struct;
    const char    *strs = (const char *)(base + off_strings);

    int depth = 0;
    int in_memory = 0;
    int count = 0;

    for (;;) {
        uint32_t tok = be32(p);
        p += 4;

        if (tok == FDT_BEGIN_NODE) {
            const char *name = (const char *)p;
            size_t len = 0;
            while (name[len]) len++;
            p += (len + 4) & ~(size_t)3;

            depth++;
            if (depth == 2 && name_is(name, "memory")) in_memory = 1;
        } else if (tok == FDT_END_NODE) {
            if (depth == 2 && in_memory) in_memory = 0;
            depth--;
        } else if (tok == FDT_PROP) {
            uint32_t len     = be32(p);
            uint32_t nameoff = be32(p + 4);
            p += 8;
            const uint8_t *val = p;
            p += (len + 3) & ~3u;

            if (in_memory) {
                const char *pname = strs + nameoff;
                if (str_eq(pname, "reg")) {
                    uint32_t n = len / 16;
                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && count < max; i++) {
                        out[count].base = be64(val + i * 16);
                        out[count].size = be64(val + i * 16 + 8);
                        count++;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (tok == FDT_NOP) {
        } else if (tok == FDT_END) {
            break;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

// ---------- Framebuffer ----------
int dtb_get_framebuffer(fb_info_t *out) {
    if (!g_dtb || !out) return 0;

    const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)g_dtb;
    if (be32(base) != FDT_MAGIC) return 0;

    uint32_t off_struct  = be32(base + 8);
    uint32_t off_strings = be32(base + 12);

    const uint8_t *p    = base + off_struct;
    const char    *strs = (const char *)(base + off_strings);

    out->base = 0; out->width = 0; out->height = 0;
    out->stride = 0; out->format[0] = 0; out->valid = 0;

    int in_fb = 0;

    for (;;) {
        uint32_t tok = be32(p);
        p += 4;

        if (tok == FDT_BEGIN_NODE) {
            const char *name = (const char *)p;
            size_t len = 0;
            while (name[len]) len++;
            p += (len + 4) & ~(size_t)3;

            if (name_starts(name, "framebuffer@") ||
                name_starts(name, "simple-framebuffer@")) {
                in_fb = 1;
            }
        } else if (tok == FDT_END_NODE) {
            in_fb = 0;
        } else if (tok == FDT_PROP) {
            uint32_t len     = be32(p);
            uint32_t nameoff = be32(p + 4);
            p += 8;
            const uint8_t *val = p;
            p += (len + 3) & ~3u;

            if (in_fb) {
                const char *pname = strs + nameoff;
                if (str_eq(pname, "reg") && len >= 8) out->base = be64(val);
                else if (str_eq(pname, "width") && len >= 4)  out->width = be32(val);
                else if (str_eq(pname, "height") && len >= 4) out->height = be32(val);
                else if (str_eq(pname, "stride") && len >= 4) out->stride = be32(val);
                else if (str_eq(pname, "format") && len > 0 && len < 16) {
                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; i++) out->format[i] = (char)val[i];
                    out->format[len] = 0;
                }
            }
        } else if (tok == FDT_NOP) {
        } else if (tok == FDT_END) {
            break;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (out->base && out->width && out->height) {
        if (out->stride == 0) out->stride = out->width * 4;
        out->valid = 1;
    }
    return out->valid;
}

// ---------- PCIe ECAM ----------
// Ищем любой узел, у которого compatible содержит "pci-host-ecam-generic".
// Не важно, как он называется (pci@ или pcie@) и на какой глубине.
int dtb_get_pci_ecam(pci_ecam_t *out) {
    if (!g_dtb || !out) return 0;

    const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)g_dtb;
    if (be32(base) != FDT_MAGIC) return 0;

    uint32_t off_struct  = be32(base + 8);
    uint32_t off_strings = be32(base + 12);

    const uint8_t *p    = base + off_struct;
    const char    *strs = (const char *)(base + off_strings);

    out->ecam_base = 0;
    out->ecam_size = 0;

    // Для текущего узла отслеживаем накопленные свойства.
    int      in_pci = 0;
    int      has_ecam = 0;
    uint64_t reg_base = 0, reg_size = 0;

    for (;;) {
        uint32_t tok = be32(p);
        p += 4;

        if (tok == FDT_BEGIN_NODE) {
            const char *name = (const char *)p;
            size_t len = 0;
            while (name[len]) len++;
            p += (len + 4) & ~(size_t)3;
            (void)name;

            in_pci = 0;
            has_ecam = 0;
            reg_base = 0;
            reg_size = 0;
        } else if (tok == FDT_END_NODE) {
            if (in_pci && has_ecam && reg_base && reg_size) {
                out->ecam_base = reg_base;
                out->ecam_size = reg_size;
                return 1;
            }
            in_pci = 0;
        } else if (tok == FDT_PROP) {
            uint32_t len     = be32(p);
            uint32_t nameoff = be32(p + 4);
            p += 8;
            const uint8_t *val = p;
            p += (len + 3) & ~3u;

            const char *pname = strs + nameoff;
            if (str_eq(pname, "compatible")) {
                if (compat_contains(val, len, "pci-host-ecam-generic")) {
                    in_pci = 1;
                    has_ecam = 1;
                }
            } else if (str_eq(pname, "reg") && len >= 16) {
                // reg = <base_hi base_lo size_hi size_lo> (2 cells addr + 2 cells size)
                reg_base = be64(val);
                reg_size = be64(val + 8);
            }
        } else if (tok == FDT_NOP) {
        } else if (tok == FDT_END) {
            break;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
